# `d_ccssbu_l` Function and `d_ccssbu_l_d_selection_arl1` Function 

- USL is used to form natural clusters in code but we use API to form natural clusters in the paper theoretical part. 
- Functions`d_ccssbu_l()`  can automatically detect 3A or 3B stages to generate control charts, algorithm's out in table. 
- If we set `n_stage3A_events` to be a very large number, then the analysis will essentially be retrospective analysis.
- `d_ccssbu_l_d_selection_arl1()` used `d_ccssbu_l()` at `fit_q` and `fit_i` part.

```{r d-ccssbu-l-function}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

d_ccssbu_l <- function(file,
                       equipment_label = "Equipment A",
                       residue_type = "DAR",
                       sheet = residue_type,
                       d = 3,
                       n_stage3A_events = 10,
                       target_ARL0 = 740,
                       B = 20000,
                       c_smooth = 0.5,
                       h_min = 0.05,
                       seed = 123,
                       location_eligibility_threshold = 70,
                       location_distinct_digits = 10,
                       cluster_col = "USL",
                       cluster_group_cols = NULL,
                       cluster_round_digits = 10,
                       event_col = "Event",
                       location_col = "Location",
                       result_col = "Result",
                       lod_col = "LOD",
                       loq_col = "LOQ",
                       usl_col = "USL",
                       plot_chart = TRUE,
                       save_outputs = TRUE,
                       output_dir = file.path(getwd(), "d_CCSSBU_L_Charts"),
                       return_bootstrap_matrix = FALSE,
                       keep_bootstrap_statistics = TRUE) {

  # Checking necessary packages
  required_pkgs <- c("readxl","dplyr","ggplot2","stringr","readr","matrixStats" )
  missing_pkgs <- required_pkgs[!(required_pkgs %in% rownames(installed.packages()))]
  if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
    stop("Please install the following package(s): ", paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "))
    }
  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
  library(matrixStats)

  # Validation of arguments
  if (target_ARL0 <= 1) {stop("target_ARL0 must be greater than 1.")}
  if (B <= 0) {stop("B must be positive.")}
  if (d < 1) {stop("d must be a positive integer.")}
  if (n_stage3A_events < 1) {stop("n_stage3A_events must be a positive integer.")}
  if (c_smooth < 0) {stop("c_smooth must be nonnegative.")}
  if (h_min < 0) {stop("h_min must be nonnegative.")}
  if (location_eligibility_threshold <= 0) {
    stop("location_eligibility_threshold must be positive.")
  }
  # Create folder if no folder exists
  if (save_outputs && !dir.exists(output_dir)) {dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)}
  
  set.seed(seed)
  alpha <- 1 / target_ARL0

 
  # Helper functions
  mad_unscaled <- function(x) {
    x <- x[!is.na(x) & is.finite(x)]
    if (length(x) == 0) {return(NA_real_)}
    med_x <- median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    median(abs(x - med_x),na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  is_nd_result <- function(x) {
    x_chr <- trimws(toupper(as.character(x)))
    x_chr %in% c(
      "ND",
      "N.D.",
      "N/D",
      "NON-DETECT",
      "NONDETECT",
      "NON DETECT",
      "NOT DETECT"
    )
  }

  extract_event_number <- function(x) {
    x_chr <- trimws(as.character(x))
    x_num_direct <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x_chr))
    x_num_extracted <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(x_chr, "\\d+$")))
    dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(x_num_direct) ~ x_num_direct,
      !is.na(x_num_extracted) ~ x_num_extracted,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  }

  fast_quantile <- function(x, probs) {
    x <- x[!is.na(x) & is.finite(x)]
    if (length(x) == 0) {return(NA_real_)}
    as.numeric(stats::quantile(x = x,probs = probs,na.rm = TRUE, type = 7, names = FALSE))
  }

  safe_name <- function(x) {
    gsub(pattern = "[^A-Za-z0-9]+", replacement = "_",x = as.character(x))
  }

  safe_plot_text <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x <- gsub("_", "-", x)
    x
  }

  # Read data
   all_sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(file)

  if (!(sheet %in% all_sheets)) {
    stop("Requested sheet was not found: ", sheet,". Available sheets: ", paste(all_sheets, collapse = ", "))
  }

  message("d-CCSSBU-L equipment = ", equipment_label)
  message("Residue type = ", residue_type)
  message("Sheet used = ", sheet)
  message("Cluster column = ", cluster_col)
  message("d = ", d,
    "; n_stage3A_events = ", n_stage3A_events,
    "; target ARL0 = ", target_ARL0,
    "; alpha = ", signif(alpha, 5),
    "; B = ", B,
    "; c_smooth = ", c_smooth,
    "; h_min = ", h_min,
    "; location eligibility threshold = ", location_eligibility_threshold,
    "; seed = ", seed
  )

  dat_raw <- readxl::read_excel(path = file,sheet = sheet)

  dat_raw <- dat_raw %>%dplyr::rename_with(~ stringr::str_trim(.x))

  result_col_actual <- result_col

  if (!(result_col_actual %in% names(dat_raw)) && residue_type %in% names(dat_raw)) {
    result_col_actual <- residue_type
  }

  required_cols <- c(
    event_col,
    location_col,
    result_col_actual,
    lod_col,
    loq_col,
    usl_col,
    cluster_col
  )

  if (!is.null(cluster_group_cols)) {required_cols <- c(required_cols, cluster_group_cols)}

  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols,names(dat_raw))

  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop("Sheet ", sheet, " is missing required columns: ",paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }
  # Step 1. Replace non-detects.
  # Step 2. Conduct USL-normalization.
  normalized_data <- dat_raw %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Equipment = equipment_label,
      ResidueType = residue_type,
      Event = extract_event_number(.data[[event_col]]),
      Location = as.character(.data[[location_col]]),
      Result_chr = trimws(as.character(.data[[result_col_actual]])),
      ND_flag = is_nd_result(Result_chr),
      Result_raw = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Result_chr)),
      LOD = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[lod_col]])),
      LOQ = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[loq_col]])),
      USL = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[usl_col]])),
      Cluster_Value_Raw = .data[[cluster_col]],
      Cluster_Value_Numeric = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[cluster_col]])),
      Cluster_Value = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(Cluster_Value_Numeric) ~ as.character(round(Cluster_Value_Numeric, cluster_round_digits)),
        TRUE ~ trimws(as.character(Cluster_Value_Raw))
      ),
      Result_Replacement_Source = dplyr::case_when(
        ND_flag & !is.na(LOD) ~ "ND replaced by LOD",
        ND_flag & is.na(LOD) & !is.na(LOQ) ~ "ND replaced by LOQ",
        ND_flag & is.na(LOD) & is.na(LOQ) ~ "Removed: ND with missing LOD and LOQ",
        !ND_flag & !is.na(Result_raw) ~ "Observed Result",
        !ND_flag & is.na(Result_raw) ~ "Removed: missing or nonnumeric Result",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      Result_ND_Replaced = dplyr::case_when(
        ND_flag & !is.na(LOD) ~ LOD,
        ND_flag & is.na(LOD) & !is.na(LOQ) ~ LOQ,
        ND_flag & is.na(LOD) & is.na(LOQ) ~ NA_real_,
        !ND_flag & !is.na(Result_raw) ~ Result_raw,
        !ND_flag & is.na(Result_raw) ~ NA_real_,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    )

  n_removed_nd_missing_lod_loq <- sum(
    normalized_data$ND_flag &
      is.na(normalized_data$LOD) &
      is.na(normalized_data$LOQ),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  n_removed_missing_result <- sum(
    !normalized_data$ND_flag &
      is.na(normalized_data$Result_raw),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  if (n_removed_nd_missing_lod_loq > 0) {
    warning(
      n_removed_nd_missing_lod_loq,
      " ND row(s) removed because both LOD and LOQ were missing."
    )
  }

  if (n_removed_missing_result > 0) {
    warning(
      n_removed_missing_result,
      " non-ND row(s) removed because Result was missing or nonnumeric."
    )
  }

  normalized_data <- normalized_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !(ND_flag & is.na(LOD) & is.na(LOQ)),
      !(!ND_flag & is.na(Result_raw)),
      !is.na(Event),
      !is.na(USL),
      USL > 0,
      !is.na(Cluster_Value),
      Cluster_Value != ""
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Normalized = 100 * Result_ND_Replaced / USL
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(Normalized),
      is.finite(Normalized)
    )

  if (nrow(normalized_data) == 0) {
    stop("No usable observations remain after ND replacement and USL-normalization.")
  }

  # Cluster key construction.
  # The manuscript refers to DAR clusters. Implementation uses
  # cluster_col, default USL, because practically DAR/CAR/Mic
  # heterogeneity is reflected by USL and residue type.

  if (is.null(cluster_group_cols)) {

    normalized_data <- normalized_data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key = paste(
          ResidueType,
          cluster_col,
          Cluster_Value,
          sep = " | "
        )
      )

  } else {
    group_key_df <- normalized_data %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(cluster_group_cols)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), ~ trimws(as.character(.x)))) %>%
      as.data.frame()

    group_key <- do.call( paste,c(group_key_df, sep = " | "))
    
    normalized_data$d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key <- paste(
      normalized_data$ResidueType,
      group_key,
      cluster_col,
      normalized_data$Cluster_Value,
      sep = " | "
    )
  }

  normalized_data <- normalized_data %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Equipment,
      ResidueType,
      Event,
      Location,
      Result_chr,
      Result_raw,
      LOD,
      LOQ,
      USL,
      Cluster_Value,
      d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key,
      ND_flag,
      Result_Replacement_Source,
      Result_ND_Replaced,
      Normalized,
      dplyr::everything()
    )

  # Chronological sequence D = {e1, ..., ex}.
  event_levels <- normalized_data %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Event) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Event) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Event_index = dplyr::row_number())

  normalized_data <- normalized_data %>%
    dplyr::left_join( event_levels,  by = "Event") %>% 
    dplyr::arrange( Event_index,Location)

  # Check one-event-one-cluster assumption.
  event_cluster_check <- normalized_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Event, Event_index) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_clusters_in_event = dplyr::n_distinct(d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key),
      cluster_keys = paste(unique(d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key), collapse = "; "),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_clusters_in_event > 1)

  if (nrow(event_cluster_check) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Some cleaning events belong to more than one d-CCSSBU-L cluster. ",
      "This violates the algorithm's partition assumption. ",
      "Check whether cluster_col = '", cluster_col, "' is constant within each event. ",
      "Example event(s): ",
      paste(head(event_cluster_check$Event, 10), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # Step 3. Define event-level location L_t and scale S_t.
  # In d-CCSSBU-L, L_t is monitored and S_t is diagnostic.
event_statistics <- normalized_data |>
  dplyr::group_by(Event,Event_index) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    Equipment =   dplyr::first(Equipment),
    ResidueType =  dplyr::first(ResidueType),
    d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key =dplyr::first(d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key),
    Cluster_Value = dplyr::first(Cluster_Value),
    L_t = median( Normalized,  na.rm = TRUE),
    S_t = mad_unscaled( Normalized),
    Max_Z_t = max(Normalized, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min_Z_t =  min( Normalized, na.rm = TRUE),
    m_t = dplyr::n(),
    n_locations_observed =dplyr::n_distinct(Location),
    n_zero_values = sum(Normalized == 0,na.rm = TRUE),
    n_positive_values = sum(Normalized > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_ND_values = sum(ND_flag,na.rm = TRUE),
    all_ND_event =all(ND_flag),
    n_distinct_normalized_values =dplyr::n_distinct(round(Normalized,location_distinct_digits),na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(all_normalized_values_identical =.data$n_distinct_normalized_values == 1) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Event_index) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    L_t_distinct_key =round(L_t,location_distinct_digits),
    Location_Calibration_Eligible =  Max_Z_t <location_eligibility_threshold
    )
  
  x <- nrow(event_statistics)
  if (x < n_stage3A_events) {
    stop("At least ", n_stage3A_events,
      " cleaning events are required. Current number of events x = ",
      x,".")
  }

  # Step 4. Define nominal D_3A and D_3B.
  D_3A_event_index <- seq_len(n_stage3A_events)
  D_3A_event_ids <- event_statistics$Event[D_3A_event_index]
  if (x == n_stage3A_events) {
    D_3B_event_index <- integer(0)
    D_3B_event_ids <- numeric(0)
    analysis_stage <- "Initial Stage 3A analysis"
  } else {
    D_3B_event_index <- (n_stage3A_events + 1):x
    D_3B_event_ids <- event_statistics$Event[D_3B_event_index]
    analysis_stage <- "Stage 3B analysis with post-Stage 3A events available"
  }

  event_statistics <- event_statistics %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      In_D_3A = Event_index %in% D_3A_event_index,
      In_D_3B = Event_index %in% D_3B_event_index
    )
  # Step 5. Define DAR clusters using only events eligible for
  # location calibration, i.e., Max_Z_t < location_eligibility_threshold.

  event_statistics_eligible <- event_statistics %>%dplyr::filter(Location_Calibration_Eligible)

  if (nrow(event_statistics_eligible) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No event is eligible for d-CCSSBU-L location calibration. ",
      "All events have Max_Z_t >= location_eligibility_threshold = ",
      location_eligibility_threshold, "." )
  }


  # Step 6. Order DAR clusters by location.
  # Clusters are ordered by L_DAR_j = median L_t over eligible events.

  cluster_summary <- event_statistics_eligible %>%
    dplyr::group_by(d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key, Cluster_Value) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      L_cluster = median(L_t, na.rm = TRUE),
      S_cluster_diagnostic = median(S_t, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_events_cluster = dplyr::n(),
      n_events_cluster_in_D_3A = sum(In_D_3A),
      n_events_cluster_in_D_3B = sum(In_D_3B),
      first_event_index_cluster = min(Event_index, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_L_t_cluster = max(L_t, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_L_t_cluster = min(L_t, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_distinct_L_t_cluster = dplyr::n_distinct(L_t_distinct_key),
      n_all_ND_events_cluster = sum(all_ND_event, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(L_cluster),
      first_event_index_cluster,
      d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      ordered_cluster_rank = dplyr::row_number()
    )

  q <- nrow(cluster_summary)
  if (q == 0) {stop("No eligible DAR clusters are available for d-CCSSBU-L calibration.")}

  if (d > q) {
    warning("Input d = ", d," is larger than q = ", q,". Setting d = q.")
    d <- q}

  selected_cluster_keys <- cluster_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(ordered_cluster_rank <= d) %>%
    dplyr::pull(d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key)

  event_statistics <- event_statistics %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      cluster_summary %>%
        dplyr::select(
          d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key,
          L_cluster,
          S_cluster_diagnostic,
          ordered_cluster_rank
        ),by = "d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key" ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Event_index) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(In_first_d_ordered_clusters = d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key %in% selected_cluster_keys)

  # Step 7. Construct Stage 3A ordered DAR cluster summaries.

  stage3A_ordered_cluster_summary <- event_statistics %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Location_Calibration_Eligible,
      !is.na(ordered_cluster_rank)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      ordered_cluster_rank,
      d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key,
      Cluster_Value) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_stage3A_component = sum(In_D_3A),
      stage3A_event_index = paste(Event_index[In_D_3A], collapse = ", "),
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(ordered_cluster_rank)


  # Step 8. Select d.
  # d has already been supplied to the function or reduced to q.
  # Step 9. Construct the d-CCSSBU-L calibration dataset.
  # For each selected ordered DAR cluster:
  # Rule 9.1: order events by decreasing L_t.
  # Rule 9.2: select distinct L_t values first, with Stage 3A tie priority.
  # Rule 9.3: if fewer than n_3A, fill using repeated L_t values.

  select_cluster_calibration_events <- function(cluster_key_j) {

    candidates <- event_statistics %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        Location_Calibration_Eligible,
        d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key == cluster_key_j) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(
        dplyr::desc(L_t),
        dplyr::desc(In_D_3A),
        Event_index
      )

    if (nrow(candidates) == 0) {return(list(selected_index = integer(0), selection_detail = data.frame()))}

    selected_index <- integer(0)
    selected_round <- character(0)

    distinct_keys_order <- candidates %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(L_t_distinct_key)) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(L_t_distinct_key, .keep_all = FALSE) %>%
      dplyr::pull(L_t_distinct_key)

    # Rule 9.2. Selection Round One: distinct L_t values first.
    for (l_key in distinct_keys_order) {
      if (length(selected_index) >= n_stage3A_events) { break }
      
      candidates_l <- candidates %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          L_t_distinct_key == l_key,
          !(Event_index %in% selected_index)) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(In_D_3A),Event_index)

      if (nrow(candidates_l) > 0) {
        selected_index <- c(selected_index, candidates_l$Event_index[1] )
        selected_round <- c(selected_round, "Round 1: distinct L_t" )
      }
    }

    # Rule 9.3. Selection Round Two: repeated L_t values if needed.
    if (length(selected_index) < n_stage3A_events) {

      remaining_candidates <- candidates %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          !(Event_index %in% selected_index)) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(
          dplyr::desc(L_t),
          dplyr::desc(In_D_3A),
          Event_index)
      
      if (nrow(remaining_candidates) > 0) {
        for (ii in seq_len(nrow(remaining_candidates))) {
          if (length(selected_index) >= n_stage3A_events) {break}
          selected_index <- c(selected_index,remaining_candidates$Event_index[ii])
          selected_round <- c(selected_round,"Round 2: repeated L_t")}}
    }

    selection_detail <- candidates %>%
      dplyr::filter(Event_index %in% selected_index) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Selection_Order = match(Event_index, selected_index),
        Selection_Round = selected_round[match(Event_index, selected_index)]) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(Selection_Order)

    list(selected_index = selected_index,selection_detail = selection_detail)
  } #select_cluster_calibration_events end

  selected_cluster_summary <- cluster_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(ordered_cluster_rank <= d) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(ordered_cluster_rank)

  cluster_selection_list <- lapply(
    selected_cluster_summary$d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key,
    select_cluster_calibration_events
  )

  names(cluster_selection_list) <- selected_cluster_summary$d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key

  D_Cal_L_event_index_by_cluster <- lapply(
    cluster_selection_list,
    function(x) {x$selected_index}
  )

  D_Cal_L_event_index <- sort(unique(unlist(D_Cal_L_event_index_by_cluster)))

  if (length(D_Cal_L_event_index) == 0) {
    stop(
      "D_Cal,L(d) is empty. Bootstrap limits cannot be estimated. ",
      "Increase d or check the location eligibility threshold."
    )
  }

  cluster_selection_detail <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(
      seq_along(cluster_selection_list),
      function(ii) {
        detail_i <- cluster_selection_list[[ii]]$selection_detail
        if (nrow(detail_i) == 0) {return(NULL)}
        detail_i %>%dplyr::mutate(selected_cluster_key = names(cluster_selection_list)[ii])
      }
    )
  ) #  cluster_selection_detail

  if (is.null(cluster_selection_detail) || nrow(cluster_selection_detail) == 0) {
    cluster_selection_detail <- data.frame()
  }

  cluster_calibration_status <- selected_cluster_summary %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_j = n_events_cluster,
      n_Cal_j = length(D_Cal_L_event_index_by_cluster[[d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key]]),
      calibration_complete_j = n_Cal_j == n_stage3A_events,
      calibration_limited_j = n_Cal_j < n_stage3A_events
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  D_Cal_L_event_ids <- event_statistics$Event[match(D_Cal_L_event_index, event_statistics$Event_index)]
  D_Aug_L_event_index <- sort(setdiff(D_Cal_L_event_index, D_3A_event_index))
  D_Aug_L_event_ids <- event_statistics$Event[match(D_Aug_L_event_index, event_statistics$Event_index)]
  n_Cal <- length(D_Cal_L_event_index)
  all_selected_clusters_complete <- all(cluster_calibration_status$calibration_complete_j )

   # Step 10. Determine calibration status and Cases 1 to 5.
  case_label <- NA_character_
  case_name <- NA_character_
  case_definition <- NA_character_
  calibration_finalized <- FALSE

  if (x == n_stage3A_events && all_selected_clusters_complete) {
    case_label <- "Case 1"
    case_name <- "Initial Stage 3A Complete"
    case_definition <- paste0(
      "x = n3A and n_Cal,j = n3A for every selected ordered DAR cluster. ",
      "The location-calibration dataset is finalized using currently available eligible events."
    )
    calibration_finalized <- TRUE

  } else if (x == n_stage3A_events && !all_selected_clusters_complete) {
    case_label <- "Case 2"
    case_name <- "Initial Stage 3A Calibration Limited"
    case_definition <- paste0(
      "x = n3A and n_Cal,j < n3A for at least one selected ordered DAR cluster. ",
      "No post-Stage 3A events are available yet. ",
      "The location-calibration dataset remains provisional."
    )
    calibration_finalized <- FALSE
  } else if (x > n_stage3A_events &&all_selected_clusters_complete &&length(D_Aug_L_event_index) == 0) {
    case_label <- "Case 3"
    case_name <- "Stage 3B Available, Calibration Finalized Without Post-Stage 3A Supplementation"
    case_definition <- paste0(
      "x > n3A, n_Cal,j = n3A for every selected ordered DAR cluster, ",
      "and D_Aug,L(d) is empty. ",
      "The location-calibration dataset is finalized without post-Stage 3A supplementation."
    )
    calibration_finalized <- TRUE
  } else if ( x > n_stage3A_events && all_selected_clusters_complete && length(D_Aug_L_event_index) > 0) {
    case_label <- "Case 4"
    case_name <- "Stage 3B Available, Calibration Finalized With Post-Stage 3A Supplementation"
    case_definition <- paste0(
      "x > n3A, n_Cal,j = n3A for every selected ordered DAR cluster, ",
      "and D_Aug,L(d) is not empty. ",
      "The location-calibration dataset is finalized after including selected eligible post-Stage 3A events."
    )
    calibration_finalized <- TRUE
  } else if ( x > n_stage3A_events && !all_selected_clusters_complete) {
    case_label <- "Case 5"
    case_name <- "Stage 3B Available, Calibration Still Provisional"
    case_definition <- paste0(
      "x > n3A and n_Cal,j < n3A for at least one selected ordered DAR cluster ",
      "after all currently available eligible events from that cluster have been exhausted. ",
      "The location-calibration dataset remains provisional."
    )
    calibration_finalized <- FALSE
  }

  if (case_label == "Case 3") {monitoring_event_index <- D_3B_event_index
  } else if (case_label == "Case 4") {
    monitoring_event_index <- setdiff(D_3B_event_index, D_Aug_L_event_index)
  } else {monitoring_event_index <- integer(0)}

  monitoring_event_ids <- event_statistics$Event[match(monitoring_event_index, event_statistics$Event_index)]

  event_statistics <- event_statistics %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Used_for_d_CCSSBU_L_calibration = Event_index %in% D_Cal_L_event_index,
      Used_for_d_CCSSBU_L_augmented_calibration = Event_index %in% D_Aug_L_event_index,
      Used_for_d_CCSSBU_L_monitoring = Event_index %in% monitoring_event_index
    )

  limits_estimated <- TRUE
  limits_finalized <- calibration_finalized
  limit_status <- dplyr::case_when(
    case_label == "Case 1" ~
      "Complete d-CCSSBU-L bootstrap limits estimated from D_Cal,L(d) at initial Stage 3A analysis.",

    case_label == "Case 2" ~
      "Provisional d-CCSSBU-L bootstrap limits estimated from the currently available D_Cal,L(d). Additional events are required before routine Stage 3B monitoring.",

    case_label == "Case 3" ~
      "Complete d-CCSSBU-L bootstrap limits estimated from D_Cal,L(d) without post-Stage 3A supplementation.",

    case_label == "Case 4" ~
      "Complete d-CCSSBU-L bootstrap limits estimated from D_Cal,L(d) with selected post-Stage 3A supplementation.",

    case_label == "Case 5" ~
      "Provisional d-CCSSBU-L bootstrap limits estimated from the currently available D_Cal,L(d). Additional eligible events may update the chart in a future analysis cycle.",

    TRUE ~  "d-CCSSBU-L bootstrap limits estimated from the current D_Cal,L(d)."
  )

  message("Automatic analysis stage: ", analysis_stage)
  message("Case label: ", case_label, " (", case_name, ")")
  message("Case definition: ", case_definition)
  message("Total events x = ", x)
  message("Number of ordered eligible clusters q = ", q)
  message("Selected d = ", d)
  message("Current nCal = ", n_Cal)
  message("Calibration finalized = ", calibration_finalized)
  message("Limits estimated = ", limits_estimated)
  message("Limits finalized = ", limits_finalized)
  message("DCalL event index: ", paste(D_Cal_L_event_index, collapse = ", "))

  if (length(D_Aug_L_event_index) > 0) {
    message("DAugL event index: ", paste(D_Aug_L_event_index, collapse = ", "))
  } else {message("DAugL event index: none.") }

  if (length(monitoring_event_index) > 0) {
    message("Monitoring event index: ", paste(monitoring_event_index, collapse = ", "))
  } else {message("Monitoring event index: none.")}

  # Steps 11 to 14. Bootstrap calibration.
  calibrate_d_ccssbu_l_bootstrap <- function(calibration_event_index,seed_internal) {

    set.seed(seed_internal)

    calibration_data <- normalized_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(Event_index %in% calibration_event_index)

    if (nrow(calibration_data) == 0) {stop("No calibration data available for d-CCSSBU-L bootstrap.")}

    loc_data <- split(calibration_data, calibration_data$Location)

    loc_data <- loc_data[
      vapply(
        loc_data,
        function(dloc) {any(!is.na(dloc$Normalized) & is.finite(dloc$Normalized))},
        logical(1)
      )
    ]

    if (length(loc_data) == 0) {stop("No valid sampling-location strata are available for bootstrap.")}

    loc_data <- loc_data[sort(names(loc_data))]

    h_values <- vapply(
      loc_data,
      function(dloc) {
        z <- dloc$Normalized
        z <- z[!is.na(z) & is.finite(z)]
        h_raw <- c_smooth * mad_unscaled(z)
        if (is.na(h_raw) || !is.finite(h_raw)) {h_raw <- 0}
        max(h_raw, h_min)
      },
      numeric(1)
    )

    h_values[!is.finite(h_values)] <- h_min

    n_bootstrap_locations <- length(loc_data)

    boot_mat <- matrix( NA_real_, nrow = B,ncol = n_bootstrap_locations)

    colnames(boot_mat) <- names(loc_data)

    for (rr in seq_len(n_bootstrap_locations)) {
      z_r <- loc_data[[rr]]$Normalized
      z_r <- z_r[!is.na(z_r) & is.finite(z_r)]
      if (length(z_r) == 0) {stop("A sampling-location stratum has no valid normalized values.")}
      sampled_index <- sample.int(n = length(z_r),size = B, replace = TRUE)
      sampled_value <- z_r[sampled_index]
      h_r <- h_values[rr]
      eps <- if (is.na(h_r) || !is.finite(h_r) || h_r == 0) {numeric(B)
      } else {stats::rnorm(n = B,mean = 0,sd = h_r)}
      boot_mat[, rr] <- pmax(0,sampled_value + eps)
    } #for loop end

    if (n_bootstrap_locations == 1) {L_boot <- boot_mat[, 1]
    } else {L_boot <- matrixStats::rowMedians(boot_mat,na.rm = TRUE)}

    CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot <- median( L_boot,na.rm = TRUE)
    UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot <- fast_quantile(L_boot,probs = 1 - alpha)
    empirical_p0 <- mean(L_boot > UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,na.rm = TRUE)
    empirical_ARL0 <- ifelse(empirical_p0 > 0,1 / empirical_p0, Inf)

    bootstrap_strata_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      lapply(
        names(loc_data),
        function(loc_name) {
          z <- loc_data[[loc_name]]$Normalized
          z <- z[!is.na(z) & is.finite(z)]

          data.frame(
            Location = loc_name,
            n = length(z),
            median = median(z, na.rm = TRUE),
            MAD = mad_unscaled(z),
            h = h_values[loc_name],
            min = min(z, na.rm = TRUE),
            max = max(z, na.rm = TRUE)
          )
        } # end of function
      ) # end of lapply
    ) #end of bootstrap_strata_summary

    boot_mat_out <- if (return_bootstrap_matrix) {boot_mat} else {NULL}
    L_boot_out <- if (keep_bootstrap_statistics) {L_boot} else {NULL}

    list(
      calibration_data = calibration_data,
      bootstrap_strata_summary = bootstrap_strata_summary,
      bootstrap_h_values = h_values,
      bootstrap_location_matrix = boot_mat_out,
      L_d_ccssbu_l_boot = L_boot_out,
      CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot = CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,
      UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot = UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,
      empirical_p0_from_bootstrap = empirical_p0,
      empirical_ARL0_from_bootstrap = empirical_ARL0,
      n_bootstrap_locations = n_bootstrap_locations,
      bootstrap_location_names = names(loc_data)
    )
  } #  calibrate_d_ccssbu_l_bootstrap end

  boot_obj <- calibrate_d_ccssbu_l_bootstrap(
    calibration_event_index = D_Cal_L_event_index,
    seed_internal = seed + 1
  )

  calibration_data <- boot_obj$calibration_data
  bootstrap_strata_summary <- boot_obj$bootstrap_strata_summary
  bootstrap_h_values <- boot_obj$bootstrap_h_values
  bootstrap_location_matrix <- boot_obj$bootstrap_location_matrix
  bootstrap_statistics <- boot_obj$L_d_ccssbu_l_boot
  CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot <- boot_obj$CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot
  UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot <- boot_obj$UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot
  empirical_p0_from_bootstrap <- boot_obj$empirical_p0_from_bootstrap
  empirical_ARL0_from_bootstrap <- boot_obj$empirical_ARL0_from_bootstrap
  bootstrap_location_names <- boot_obj$bootstrap_location_names
  CL_obs <- median(event_statistics$L_t,na.rm = TRUE)

  # Steps 15 and 16. Chart data and monitoring classification.


  chart_data <- event_statistics %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot = CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,
      UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot = UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,
      CL_obs = CL_obs,
      Signal_d_CCSSBU_L = L_t > UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,
      Stage_Status = dplyr::case_when(
        Used_for_d_CCSSBU_L_calibration & Used_for_d_CCSSBU_L_augmented_calibration ~
          "Post-Stage 3A event used for d-CCSSBU-L location calibration",

        Used_for_d_CCSSBU_L_calibration & Event_index %in% D_3A_event_index ~
          "Nominal Stage 3A event used for d-CCSSBU-L location calibration",

        !Location_Calibration_Eligible & Event_index %in% D_3A_event_index ~
          "Nominal Stage 3A event not eligible for location calibration",

        !Location_Calibration_Eligible & Event_index %in% D_3B_event_index ~
          "Stage 3B event not eligible for location calibration",

        Event_index %in% D_3A_event_index ~
          "Nominal Stage 3A event not selected for current d-CCSSBU-L calibration",

        Event_index %in% monitoring_event_index ~
          "Stage 3B monitoring event",

        Event_index %in% D_3B_event_index ~
          "Post-Stage 3A event not used for current monitoring set",

        TRUE ~  "Unclassified event"),
      
      Limit_Status = limit_status,
      OOC_Event_Label = dplyr::case_when(
        Signal_d_CCSSBU_L ~ paste0("OOC:", Event),
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) #chart_data end

  ooc_events <- chart_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(Signal_d_CCSSBU_L) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Equipment,
      ResidueType,
      Event,
      Event_index,
      L_t,
      S_t,
      Max_Z_t,
      Location_Calibration_Eligible,
      d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key,
      Cluster_Value,
      ordered_cluster_rank,
      L_cluster,
      S_cluster_diagnostic,
      UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,
      CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,
      CL_obs,
      m_t,
      n_locations_observed,
      all_ND_event,
      Stage_Status,
      Used_for_d_CCSSBU_L_calibration,
      Used_for_d_CCSSBU_L_augmented_calibration,
      Used_for_d_CCSSBU_L_monitoring,
      OOC_Event_Label
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Event_index)

  n_ooc_events <- nrow(ooc_events)

  n_stage3A_ooc <- chart_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(Signal_d_CCSSBU_L,Event_index %in% D_3A_event_index ) %>% nrow()

  n_stage3B_ooc <- chart_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(Signal_d_CCSSBU_L,Event_index %in% monitoring_event_index) %>%nrow()
  
  n_ND_ooc <- chart_data |>
  dplyr::filter(all_normalized_values_identical,Signal_d_CCSSBU_L) |> nrow()


  stage3B_ooc_labels <- chart_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(Signal_d_CCSSBU_L,Event_index %in% monitoring_event_index) %>%
    dplyr::pull(OOC_Event_Label)

  if (n_ooc_events > 0) {
    message(
      "Number of candidate OOC cleaning event(s): ",
      n_ooc_events,
      ". Candidate OOC event label(s): ",
      paste(ooc_events$OOC_Event_Label, collapse = ", ")
    )
  } else {message("No candidate OOC cleaning events detected.") }


  # Plot.
  chart_title <- paste0("d-CCSSBU-L for ",safe_plot_text(residue_type)," of ",safe_plot_text(equipment_label) )

  chart_subtitle <- paste0(
    safe_plot_text(case_label),
    " | d=", d, "/", q,
    " | nCal=", n_Cal,
    " | UCLboot=", signif(UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot, 4),
    " | CLboot=", signif(CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot, 4)
  )
  chart_subtitle <- stringr::str_wrap(chart_subtitle, width = 120 )
  chart_caption <- paste0(
    "Stage 3A OOC = ", n_stage3A_ooc,
    "; Stage 3B OOC = ", n_stage3B_ooc,
    "; nCal = ", n_Cal,
    "; d = ", d, "/", q,
    "; ",
    ifelse(limits_finalized,"Finalized limits","Provisional limits" )
  )

  chart_caption <- stringr::str_wrap( chart_caption,width = 100)

  point_size_main <- 0.42
  point_size_aug <- 0.90
  point_stroke_aug <- 0.25

  ooc_label_size <- 2.05
  limit_label_size_ucl <- 2.15
  limit_label_size_cl <- 1.95
  boundary_label_size <- 1.65

  plot_title_size <- 10
  plot_subtitle_size <- 6.5
  plot_caption_size <- 5.8

  legend_title_size <- 6.2
  legend_text_size <- 5.8
  axis_title_size <- 8.2
  axis_text_size <- 6.8

  event_breaks_plot <- pretty(chart_data$Event_index, n = 10)

  event_breaks_plot <- event_breaks_plot[event_breaks_plot >= min(chart_data$Event_index) &event_breaks_plot <= max(chart_data$Event_index)]

  event_labels <- chart_data %>%dplyr::distinct(Event_index, Event) %>%dplyr::arrange(Event_index)

  y_max_candidates <- c(chart_data$L_t, UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,CL_obs)

  y_max_plot <- max(y_max_candidates[is.finite(y_max_candidates)],na.rm = TRUE)
  y_upper_plot <- ifelse(y_max_plot <= 0,1, y_max_plot * 1.30 )
  x_min_plot <- min(chart_data$Event_index, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_max_plot <- max(chart_data$Event_index, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_range_plot <- max(1, x_max_plot - x_min_plot)
  x_label_pos <- x_max_plot + 0.025 * x_range_plot

  label_gap <- 0.028 * y_upper_plot
  ucl_label <- paste0("UCLboot = ", signif(UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot, 4))
  cl_boot_label <- paste0("CLboot = ", signif(CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot, 4))
  cl_obs_label <- paste0("CLobs = ", signif(CL_obs, 4))

  ucl_label_y <- min(UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot + 0.022 * y_upper_plot,y_upper_plot * 0.985)
  cl_boot_label_y <- min( CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot + label_gap, y_upper_plot * 0.94)
  cl_obs_label_y <- max(CL_obs - label_gap, y_upper_plot * 0.02 )
  
  if (abs(CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot - CL_obs) < 2 * label_gap) {
    cl_boot_label_y <- min( max(CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot, CL_obs) + 1.3 * label_gap,y_upper_plot * 0.94)
    cl_obs_label_y <- max(min(CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot, CL_obs) - 1.3 * label_gap,y_upper_plot * 0.02 )
  }

  ooc_plot_data <- chart_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(Signal_d_CCSSBU_L) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(OOC_Label_Y = pmax(L_t, UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot) + 0.025 * y_upper_plot)

  plot_obj <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    chart_data,
    ggplot2::aes( x = Event_index,y = L_t,group = 1)) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(color = "black",linewidth = 0.25) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(color = Signal_d_CCSSBU_L),size = point_size_main) +
    ggplot2::geom_text( data = ooc_plot_data, ggplot2::aes(x = Event_index,y = OOC_Label_Y,label = OOC_Event_Label),
      color = "red",hjust = -0.05,vjust = 0,size = ooc_label_size,check_overlap = TRUE) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,linetype = "dashed", color = "red",linewidth = 0.65) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,linetype = "solid", color = "blue", linewidth = 0.55) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = CL_obs,linetype = "dotted",color = "grey35", linewidth = 0.50) +
    ggplot2::annotate("segment",  x = x_max_plot,   xend = x_label_pos - 0.005 * x_range_plot,
      y = UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,  yend = ucl_label_y,   color = "red",  linewidth = 0.28, linetype = "dashed") +
    ggplot2::annotate("segment",  x = x_max_plot,   xend = x_label_pos - 0.005 * x_range_plot,  y = CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,
      yend = cl_boot_label_y,  color = "blue",  linewidth = 0.28, linetype = "solid") +
    ggplot2::annotate("segment",x = x_max_plot,xend = x_label_pos - 0.005 * x_range_plot, y = CL_obs, yend = cl_obs_label_y,
      color = "grey35", linewidth = 0.28, linetype = "dotted" ) +
    ggplot2::annotate("text", x = x_label_pos,y = ucl_label_y,label = ucl_label,color = "red",
      hjust = 0,vjust = 0.5,size = limit_label_size_ucl ) +
    ggplot2::annotate("text", x = x_label_pos,y = cl_boot_label_y,label = cl_boot_label,color = "blue",
      hjust = 0,vjust = 0.5,size = limit_label_size_cl) +
    ggplot2::annotate("text", x = x_label_pos,y = cl_obs_label_y, label = cl_obs_label, color = "grey35",
      hjust = 0,  vjust = 0.5,  size = limit_label_size_cl) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "black", "TRUE" = "red"),labels = c("FALSE" = "In control","TRUE" = "Candidate OOC")) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = event_breaks_plot,labels = event_labels$Event[match(event_breaks_plot, event_labels$Event_index)]) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, y_upper_plot),expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08))) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = chart_title,subtitle = chart_subtitle,caption = chart_caption,x = "Cleaning Event",
      y = expression(L[t]),color = "Signal") +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off",xlim = c(x_min_plot,x_max_plot + 0.08 * x_range_plot)) +
    ggplot2::guides(color = ggplot2::guide_legend(nrow = 1,  byrow = TRUE,override.aes = list(size = 1.1))) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = plot_title_size,face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = plot_subtitle_size,lineheight = 1.05),
      plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(size = plot_caption_size,hjust = 0,lineheight = 1.05),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 8,r = 75, b = 8,l = 8),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.justification = "center",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = legend_title_size),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = legend_text_size),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = axis_title_size),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = axis_text_size),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 0,hjust = 0.5)
    )

  if (x > n_stage3A_events) {
    boundary_x <- n_stage3A_events + 0.5
    
    plot_obj <- plot_obj +
      ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = boundary_x,linetype = "dotdash", color = "darkgreen",linewidth = 0.65) +
      ggplot2::annotate("text",x = boundary_x + 0.010 * x_range_plot, y = y_upper_plot * 0.955,label = "Stage 3A / 3B",
        angle = 0,hjust = 0,vjust = 1,size = boundary_label_size, color = "darkgreen")
  }

  if (length(D_Aug_L_event_index) > 0) {
    plot_obj <- plot_obj +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        data = chart_data %>%
          dplyr::filter(Event_index %in% D_Aug_L_event_index),
        ggplot2::aes(x = Event_index, y = L_t),
        shape = 21,
        fill = "orange",
        color = "black",
        size = point_size_aug,
        stroke = point_stroke_aug
      )
  }

  # Output files.
  safe_equipment <- safe_name(equipment_label)
  safe_residue <- safe_name(residue_type)
  safe_cluster <- safe_name(cluster_col)
  safe_c <- gsub("\\.", "p", as.character(c_smooth))
  safe_hmin <- gsub("\\.", "p", as.character(h_min))
  safe_thresh <- gsub("\\.", "p", as.character(location_eligibility_threshold))
  file_stub <- paste0("d_CCSSBU_L_",safe_residue, "_",safe_equipment, "_cluster_",safe_cluster,"_d_",  d,
    "_ARL0_", target_ARL0,"_c_",safe_c, "_hmin_", safe_hmin,"_elig_", safe_thresh )

  chart_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(file_stub, ".png"))
  event_csv_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(file_stub, "_event_statistics.csv"))
  normalized_csv_file <- file.path(output_dir,paste0(file_stub, "_normalized_data.csv"))
  cluster_csv_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(file_stub, "_ordered_cluster_summary.csv"))
  calibration_csv_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(file_stub, "_calibration_events.csv"))
  cluster_selection_csv_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(file_stub, "_cluster_selection_detail.csv"))
  cluster_status_csv_file <- file.path(output_dir,paste0(file_stub, "_cluster_calibration_status.csv"))
  bootstrap_strata_csv_file <- file.path(output_dir,paste0(file_stub, "_bootstrap_strata_summary.csv"))
  rds_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(file_stub, "_fit.rds") )

  calibration_event_check <- chart_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(Event_index %in% D_Cal_L_event_index) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      d_CCSSBU_L_Calibration_Role = dplyr::case_when(
        Event_index %in% D_Aug_L_event_index ~ "Post-Stage 3A location-calibration event",
        Event_index %in% D_3A_event_index ~ "Nominal Stage 3A location-calibration event",
        TRUE ~ "Location-calibration event")) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Equipment,
      ResidueType,
      Event,
      Event_index,
      L_t,
      S_t,
      Max_Z_t,
      Location_Calibration_Eligible,
      d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key,
      Cluster_Value,
      ordered_cluster_rank,
      L_cluster,
      S_cluster_diagnostic,
      m_t,
      n_locations_observed,
      all_ND_event,
      d_CCSSBU_L_Calibration_Role) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(ordered_cluster_rank,dplyr::desc(L_t), Event_index)

  if (save_outputs) {
    ggplot2::ggsave(
      filename = chart_file,
      plot = plot_obj,
      width = 11,
      height = 6.2,
      units = "in",
      dpi = 600,
      bg = "white"
    )

    readr::write_csv(chart_data, event_csv_file)
    readr::write_csv(normalized_data, normalized_csv_file)
    readr::write_csv(cluster_summary, cluster_csv_file)
    readr::write_csv(calibration_event_check, calibration_csv_file)
    readr::write_csv(cluster_selection_detail, cluster_selection_csv_file)
    readr::write_csv(cluster_calibration_status, cluster_status_csv_file)
    readr::write_csv(bootstrap_strata_summary, bootstrap_strata_csv_file)
  }

  files <- list(
    chart_file = if (save_outputs) chart_file else NA_character_,
    event_statistics_csv = if (save_outputs) event_csv_file else NA_character_,
    normalized_data_csv = if (save_outputs) normalized_csv_file else NA_character_,
    ordered_cluster_summary_csv = if (save_outputs) cluster_csv_file else NA_character_,
    calibration_events_csv = if (save_outputs) calibration_csv_file else NA_character_,
    cluster_selection_detail_csv = if (save_outputs) cluster_selection_csv_file else NA_character_,
    cluster_calibration_status_csv = if (save_outputs) cluster_status_csv_file else NA_character_,
    bootstrap_strata_summary_csv = if (save_outputs) bootstrap_strata_csv_file else NA_character_,
    rds_file = if (save_outputs) rds_file else NA_character_
  )

  result <- list(
    method = "d-CCSSBU-L",
    chart_family = "CCSSBU",
    chart_statistic = "Location",
    function_name = "d_ccssbu_l",
    call = match.call(),
    file = file,
    equipment_label = equipment_label,
    residue_type = residue_type,
    sheet = sheet,
    analysis_stage = analysis_stage,
    
    case_label = case_label,
    case_name = case_name,
    case_definition = case_definition,
    calibration_finalized = calibration_finalized,
    limits_estimated = limits_estimated,
    limits_finalized = limits_finalized,
    limit_status = limit_status,
    d = d,
    q = q,
    selected_ordered_cluster_ranks = seq_len(d),
    
    selected_cluster_keys = selected_cluster_keys,
    cluster_col = cluster_col,
    cluster_group_cols = cluster_group_cols,
    cluster_round_digits = cluster_round_digits,
    n_stage3A_events = n_stage3A_events,
    n_total_events = x,
    target_ARL0 = target_ARL0,
    alpha = alpha,
    B = B,
    c_smooth = c_smooth,
    
    h_min = h_min,
    seed = seed,
    location_eligibility_threshold = location_eligibility_threshold,
    location_distinct_digits = location_distinct_digits,
    D_3A_event_index = D_3A_event_index,
    D_3A_event_ids = D_3A_event_ids,
    D_3B_event_index = D_3B_event_index,
    D_3B_event_ids = D_3B_event_ids,
    D_Cal_L_event_index_by_cluster = D_Cal_L_event_index_by_cluster,
    D_Cal_L_event_index = D_Cal_L_event_index,
    
    D_Cal_L_event_ids = D_Cal_L_event_ids,
    D_Aug_L_event_index = D_Aug_L_event_index,
    D_Aug_L_event_ids = D_Aug_L_event_ids,
    monitoring_event_index = monitoring_event_index,
    monitoring_event_ids = monitoring_event_ids,
    n_Cal = n_Cal,
    normalized_data = normalized_data,
    event_statistics = chart_data,
    event_statistics_eligible = event_statistics_eligible,
    cluster_summary = cluster_summary,
    
    stage3A_ordered_cluster_summary = stage3A_ordered_cluster_summary,
    cluster_selection_detail = cluster_selection_detail,
    cluster_calibration_status = cluster_calibration_status,
    calibration_data = calibration_data,
    calibration_event_check = calibration_event_check,
    bootstrap_strata_summary = bootstrap_strata_summary,
    CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot = CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,
    CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot_definition = paste0("Bootstrap center line: median of L_boot estimated from D_Cal,L(d)."),
    UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot = UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,
    UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot_definition = paste0("Bootstrap upper control limit: empirical 1 - alpha quantile of L_boot estimated from D_Cal,L(d)."),
    
    CL_obs = CL_obs,
    CL_obs_definition = paste0("Observed descriptive center line: median of all observed L_t values displayed on the chart. ", "It is not used as the monitoring limit."),
    bootstrap_statistics_L = bootstrap_statistics,
    bootstrap_location_matrix = bootstrap_location_matrix,
    bootstrap_h_values = bootstrap_h_values,
    bootstrap_location_names = bootstrap_location_names,
    empirical_p0_from_bootstrap = empirical_p0_from_bootstrap,
    empirical_ARL0_from_bootstrap = empirical_ARL0_from_bootstrap,
    ooc_events = ooc_events,
    n_ooc_events = n_ooc_events,
    
    n_stage3A_ooc = n_stage3A_ooc,
    n_stage3B_ooc = n_stage3B_ooc,
    n_ND_ooc = n_ND_ooc,
    stage3B_ooc_labels = stage3B_ooc_labels,
    reusable = list(all_event_index = chart_data$Event_index,
      all_event_ids = chart_data$Event,
      all_L_t = chart_data$L_t,
      all_S_t = chart_data$S_t,
      all_Max_Z_t = chart_data$Max_Z_t,
      all_cluster_key = chart_data$d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key,
      all_location_calibration_eligible = chart_data$Location_Calibration_Eligible,
      D_3A_event_index = D_3A_event_index,
      D_3B_event_index = D_3B_event_index,
      calibration_event_index = D_Cal_L_event_index,
      
      calibration_event_ids = D_Cal_L_event_ids,
      calibration_L_t = chart_data$L_t[chart_data$Event_index %in% D_Cal_L_event_index],
      calibration_S_t = chart_data$S_t[chart_data$Event_index %in% D_Cal_L_event_index],
      augmented_event_index = D_Aug_L_event_index,
      augmented_event_ids = D_Aug_L_event_ids,
      monitoring_event_index = monitoring_event_index,
      monitoring_event_ids = monitoring_event_ids,
      monitoring_L_t = chart_data$L_t[chart_data$Event_index %in% monitoring_event_index],
      monitoring_S_t = chart_data$S_t[chart_data$Event_index %in% monitoring_event_index],
      bootstrap_L_t = bootstrap_statistics,
      
      CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot = CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,
      UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot = UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,
      limits_estimated = limits_estimated,
      limits_finalized = limits_finalized,
      limit_status = limit_status,
      alpha = alpha,
      target_ARL0 = target_ARL0,
      B = B,
      c_smooth = c_smooth,
      h_min = h_min,
      
      location_eligibility_threshold = location_eligibility_threshold
    ),

    d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_rule = paste0(
      "Clusters are defined by residue type and ", cluster_col,
      ". For d-CCSSBU-L, only events with Max_Z_t < ",
      location_eligibility_threshold,
      " are eligible for location-calibration construction. ",
      "Clusters are ordered by cluster-level median L_t."),
    
    d_CCSSBU_L_calibration_rule = paste0(
      "For fixed d, D_Cal,L,j(d) is constructed separately for each of the first d ordered clusters. ",
      "Within each cluster, eligible events are ordered by decreasing L_t. ",
      "Distinct L_t values are selected first, with Stage 3A priority when tied. ",
      "If fewer than n3A events are selected, remaining repeated L_t events are added using the same ordering rule until n3A or exhaustion."),
    
    d_CCSSBU_L_limit_rule = paste0(
      "Bootstrap limits are estimated from D_Cal,L(d). In Cases 2 and 5, limits are provisional because at least one selected cluster ","has fewer than n3A eligible calibration events." ),
    
    d_CCSSBU_L_monitoring_rule = paste0(
      "Under Case 3, all D3B events are monitoring events. Under Case 4, post-Stage 3A events selected into D_Cal,L(d) ",
      "are used for location calibration and excluded from routine Stage 3B monitoring. Under Case 2 or Case 5, the chart is provisional."),
    
    chart_title = chart_title,
    
    chart_subtitle = chart_subtitle,
    chart_caption = chart_caption,
    chart = plot_obj,
    files = files
  )

  class(result) <- c("d_ccssbu_l", "ccssbu_l", "list")
  if (save_outputs) { saveRDS(object = result,file = rds_file )}
  if (plot_chart) { print(plot_obj) }

  return(result)
}
```
