```{r make_d_ccssbu_l_arl1_wide_tbl_function}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# ever used in the function  d_ccssbu_l_d_selection_arl1() but now removed
make_d_ccssbu_l_arl1_wide_tbl <- function(tbl) {
# Validate the input table
  if (!is.data.frame(tbl)) {stop("tbl must be a data frame.")}
  if (nrow(tbl) == 0) {stop("tbl contains no rows.")}
  required_columns <- c(
    "Residue",
    "d",
    "q",
    "calibration_case",
    "nCal",
    "OOC_ND",
    "OOC_3A",
    "OOC_3B",
    "benchmark_n",
    "CL",
    "UCL",
    "k",
    "Xbar_chart_ARL1",
    "ARL1")
  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns,names(tbl))
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {stop(paste0("The following required column(s) are missing from tbl: ", paste(missing_columns,collapse = ",")))}

  # Optional candidate-level columns from Steps 9 to 12
  optional_candidate_columns <- c(
    "W",
    "G",
    "in_C_d",
    "in_D1",
    "in_D2",
    "in_A",
    "in_U",
    "selected",
    "recommended_d",
    "observed_behavior_case",
    "arl_curve_case",
    "selected_case",
    "selection_rule",
    "A_values",
    "U_values",
    "selection_path",
    "recommendation_notes"
  )
  available_optional_columns <- intersect(optional_candidate_columns, names(tbl))

  # ==========================================================
  # Construct stable labels for the shift grid
  #  # Examples:
  # 0.5 becomes 0p5
  # 1.0 becomes 1
  # 1.5 becomes 1p5
  # 2.0 becomes 2
  # ==========================================================

  make_k_label <- function(x) {
    x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
    if (anyNA(x) || any(!is.finite(x))) {stop( "The k column must contain only finite numeric values." )}
    x_formatted <- format(x,scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE,digits = 15)
    x_formatted <- sub(pattern = "0+$", replacement = "", x = x_formatted)
    x_formatted <- sub(pattern = "\\.$",replacement = "", x = x_formatted)
    gsub( pattern = "\\.",replacement = "p",  x = x_formatted)
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Prepare the long-format input used for pivoting
  # ==========================================================

  selected_columns <- c(
    "Residue",
    "d",
    "q",
    "calibration_case",
    "nCal",
    "OOC_ND",
    "OOC_3A",
    "OOC_3B",
    "benchmark_n",
    "CL",
    "UCL",
    available_optional_columns,
    "rho",
    "Xbar_chart_ARL1",
    "ARL1"
  )

  selected_columns <- unique(selected_columns)

  tbl_wide_input <- tbl |>
    dplyr::mutate(rho = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data$rho)),rho_label = make_rho_label(.data$rho)) |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(selected_columns),.data$rho_label) |>
    dplyr::distinct()

  # ==========================================================
  # Confirm that every Residue-d-rho combination is unique
  # ==========================================================

  duplicate_rows <- tbl_wide_input |>
    dplyr::count( .data$Residue,.data$d,.data$rho_label,name = "n_rows" ) |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$n_rows > 1)

  if (nrow(duplicate_rows) > 0) {stop(paste0("Multiple rows were found for at least one ","Residue, d, and rho combination."))}

  # ==========================================================
  # Confirm that required d-specific columns are constant
  # across rho for each Residue and d
  # ==========================================================

  inconsistent_required_identifiers <- tbl_wide_input |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$Residue,.data$d) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_q = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$q,na.rm = FALSE),
      n_calibration_case =dplyr::n_distinct(.data$calibration_case, na.rm = FALSE),
      n_nCal =dplyr::n_distinct(.data$nCal, na.rm = FALSE),
      n_OOC_ND =dplyr::n_distinct(.data$OOC_ND, na.rm = FALSE ),
      n_OOC_3A =dplyr::n_distinct(.data$OOC_3A, na.rm = FALSE),
      n_OOC_3B =dplyr::n_distinct(.data$OOC_3B, na.rm = FALSE),
      n_benchmark_n = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$benchmark_n,na.rm = FALSE),
      n_CL =dplyr::n_distinct(.data$CL, na.rm = FALSE ),
      n_UCL = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$UCL,na.rm = FALSE ),
      .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$n_q > 1 |
        .data$n_calibration_case > 1 |
        .data$n_nCal > 1 |
        .data$n_OOC_ND > 1 |
        .data$n_OOC_3A > 1 |
        .data$n_OOC_3B > 1 |
        .data$n_benchmark_n > 1 |
        .data$n_CL > 1 |
        .data$n_UCL > 1
    )

  if (nrow(inconsistent_required_identifiers) > 0) {stop( paste0( "One or more required d-specific columns vary across rho ","for the same Residue and d combination." ) ) }

  # ==========================================================
  # Confirm that optional candidate-level columns are constant
  # across rho for each Residue and d
  # ==========================================================

  if (length(available_optional_columns) > 0) {

    inconsistent_optional_identifiers <- tbl_wide_input |>
      dplyr::group_by(.data$Residue,.data$d) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        dplyr::across(
          dplyr::all_of(available_optional_columns),~ dplyr::n_distinct(.x,na.rm = FALSE),.names = "n_{.col}"),
        .groups = "drop")

    optional_count_columns <- setdiff(names(inconsistent_optional_identifiers),c("Residue","d"))

    inconsistent_optional_identifiers <-
      inconsistent_optional_identifiers |>
      dplyr::filter(dplyr::if_any(dplyr::all_of(optional_count_columns),~ .x > 1))

    if (nrow(inconsistent_optional_identifiers) > 0) {
      stop(paste0("One or more optional candidate-level columns vary ",
          "across rho for the same Residue and d combination."))
    }
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Confirm that the Xbar benchmark is common across d
  # within each residue, benchmark subgroup size, and rho
  # ==========================================================

  benchmark_inconsistency <- tbl_wide_input |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$Residue,.data$benchmark_n,.data$rho_label) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n_benchmark_values =dplyr::n_distinct(.data$Xbar_chart_ARL1,na.rm = FALSE),.groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$n_benchmark_values > 1)

  if (nrow(benchmark_inconsistency) > 0) {
    stop(paste0("The Xbar-chart ARL1 benchmark varies across d for ",
        "at least one Residue, benchmark_n, and rho combination." ))
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Define candidate-level identifier columns
  # ==========================================================

  id_columns <- c(
    "Residue",
    "d",
    "q",
    "calibration_case",
    "nCal",
    "OOC_ND",
    "OOC_3A",
    "OOC_3B",
    "benchmark_n",
    "CL",
    "UCL",
    available_optional_columns)

  id_columns <- unique(id_columns)

  # ==========================================================
  # Pivot ARL1 values to wide format
  # ==========================================================

  tbl_wide <- tbl_wide_input |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols = dplyr::all_of(id_columns),
      names_from =.data$rho_label,
      values_from = c(.data$Xbar_chart_ARL1,.data$ARL1),
      names_glue ="{.value}_rho_{rho_label}",
      names_sort =FALSE) |>
    dplyr::arrange(match(.data$Residue,unique(tbl$Residue)),.data$d)

  # ==========================================================
  # Arrange columns into a readable order
  # ==========================================================

  leading_columns <- c(
    "Residue",
    "d",
    "q",
    "calibration_case",
    "nCal",
    "OOC_ND",
    "OOC_3A",
    "OOC_3B",
    "benchmark_n",
    "CL",
    "UCL"
  )

  optional_metric_columns <- intersect(
    c(
      "W",
      "G",
      "in_C_d",
      "in_D1",
      "in_D2",
      "in_A",
      "in_U",
      "selected",
      "recommended_d",
      "observed_behavior_case",
      "arl_curve_case",
      "selected_case",
      "selection_rule",
      "A_values",
      "U_values",
      "selection_path",
      "recommendation_notes"
    ),names(tbl_wide))

  tbl_wide |>
    dplyr::select(
      dplyr::all_of(leading_columns),
      dplyr::starts_with("Xbar_chart_ARL1_rho_"),
      dplyr::starts_with("ARL1_rho_"),
      dplyr::all_of(optional_metric_columns),
      dplyr::everything()
    )
} # end of make_d_ccssbu_l_arl1_wide_tbl
```

```{r d_ccssbu_l_d_selection_arl1_function}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
###############################################################################
# In d_ccssbu_l_d_selection_arl1, the fit_q and fit_i used d_ccssbu_l() function 
#################################################################################
d_ccssbu_l_d_selection_arl1 <- function(
    file, 
    equipment_label = "Equipment",  
    residue_types = c("DAR", "CAR", "Mic"), 
    sheets = residue_types, 
    n_stage3A_events = 10,  
    target_ARL0 = 740,
    B = 20000,
    c_smooth = 0.5,  
    h_min = 0.05,  
    seed = 2026,
    location_eligibility_threshold = 70,  
    location_distinct_digits = 10,
    cluster_col = "USL",  
    cluster_group_cols = NULL, 
    cluster_round_digits = 10,  
    rho_grid = c(0.5,1.0,1.5,2.0,2.5,3.0 ),
    T_max = 10000,  
    benchmark_n = NULL,  
    event_col = "Event",
    location_col = "Location",  
    result_col = "Result",
    lod_col = "LOD",  
    loq_col = "LOQ",  
    usl_col = "USL",
    comparison_tolerance = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps),
    round_digits = 4,  
    verbose = TRUE) {
# Check packages and function d_ccssbu_l()
  required_packages <- c("dplyr", "tibble", "tidyr" )
  missing_packages <- required_packages[!vapply(required_packages,requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE, FUN.VALUE = logical(1))]
  if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {stop("Please install the following package(s): ",paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))}
  if (!exists("d_ccssbu_l", mode = "function")) {stop(paste0("The function d_ccssbu_l() must be defined before ","running d_ccssbu_l_d_selection_arl1()."))}

# Validate arguments
  if (length(residue_types) != length(sheets)) {stop("residue_types and sheets must have the same length.") }
  if (length(residue_types) == 0) {stop( "At least one residue type must be supplied." )}
  if (length(target_ARL0) != 1||is.na(target_ARL0)||!is.finite(target_ARL0)||target_ARL0 <= 1){stop("target_ARL0 must be a finite number greater than 1.")}
  if (length(B) != 1 || is.na(B) || !is.finite(B) ||B <= 0) { stop("B must be a positive finite number.")}
  B <- as.integer(round(B))
  if (length(h_min) != 1 ||is.na(h_min) ||!is.finite(h_min) ||h_min <= 0) {stop(paste0("h_min must be a strictly positive finite number ","for the ARL1 benchmark model."))}
  if (length(T_max) != 1 ||is.na(T_max) ||!is.finite(T_max) ||T_max <= 0) {stop("T_max must be a positive finite number.")}
  T_max <- as.numeric(T_max)
  if (length(comparison_tolerance) != 1 ||is.na(comparison_tolerance) ||!is.finite(comparison_tolerance) || comparison_tolerance < 0) {stop( paste0("comparison_tolerance must be a finite ","nonnegative number." ))}

  if (length(round_digits) != 1 ||is.na(round_digits) ||!is.finite(round_digits) || round_digits < 0) {
    stop("round_digits must be a finite nonnegative integer.")}
  round_digits <- as.integer(round(round_digits))
  rho_grid <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(rho_grid))
  if (length(rho_grid) == 0 ||anyNA(rho_grid) ||any(!is.finite(rho_grid)) ||any(rho_grid <= 0)) {
    stop( paste0("rho_grid must contain finite positive numeric values. ","The IC value rho = 0 is not included in the OC ", "curve-comparison grid."))}
  rho_grid <- sort(unique(rho_grid))
  alpha <- 1 / target_ARL0
  z_limit <- stats::qnorm(p = 1 - alpha)

# General helper functions
  # Return a string by paste with comma separated
  collapse_set <- function(x) {
    x <- sort(unique(x))
    x <- x[!is.na(x)]
    if (length(x) == 0) {return("")}
    paste(x,collapse = ", " )
  }

  #W(d) and G(d) will use this function
  values_tied <- function(x, target, tolerance = comparison_tolerance) {
    if (length(x) == 0) {return(logical(0))}
    if (length(target) != 1 ||is.na(target)) {return(rep(FALSE,length(x)))}
    if (is.infinite(target)){return(is.infinite(x) & sign(x) == sign(target))}
    is.finite(x) & abs(x - target) <=  tolerance *max(1,abs(target))
  }

  # used in the function get_benchmark_n() 
  first_existing_name <- function(data, candidate_names) {
    if (is.null(data) ||!is.data.frame(data)){return(NULL)}
    matched_names <- candidate_names[candidate_names %in% names(data)]
    if (length(matched_names) == 0) {return(NULL)}
    matched_names[[1]]
  }

# Event-statistics must exist, be a data frame, and contain at least one row (from d-ccssbu-l)
  extract_event_statistics <- function(fit, residue_type, d_value) {
    event_statistics <- fit$event_statistics
    if (is.null(event_statistics) ||!is.data.frame(event_statistics) ||nrow(event_statistics) == 0){stop(paste0("No nonempty event_statistics table was returned by ","d_ccssbu_l() for residue ",residue_type," and d = ", d_value,"."))}
    tibble::as_tibble(event_statistics)}

# Return Stage 3A USL-normalized observations Z_ti extract_stage3a_z()
  extract_stage3a_z <- function(fit,residue_type) {
    normalized_data <- fit$normalized_data
    D_3A_event_index <- fit$D_3A_event_index
    if (is.null(normalized_data) ||!is.data.frame(normalized_data) ||nrow(normalized_data) == 0) {stop(paste0("A nonempty normalized_data table was not returned ","by d_ccssbu_l() for residue ",residue_type,"."))}
    required_columns <- c("Event_index","Normalized")
    missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns,names(normalized_data))
    if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {stop(paste0("The following required column(s) are missing from ","normalized_data for residue ", residue_type, ": ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "),"."))}
    D_3A_event_index <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(D_3A_event_index))
    D_3A_event_index <- sort(unique(D_3A_event_index[!is.na(D_3A_event_index)]))
    if (length(D_3A_event_index) == 0) {stop(paste0("No Stage 3A event indices were returned for residue ",residue_type,"."))}
    stage3a_z <- normalized_data |> dplyr::filter(.data$Event_index %in% D_3A_event_index) |> dplyr::pull(.data$Normalized)
    stage3a_z <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(stage3a_z))
    stage3a_z <- stage3a_z[!is.na(stage3a_z) &is.finite(stage3a_z)]
    if (length(stage3a_z) < 2) {stop(paste0("At least two finite Stage 3A USL-normalized ","observations are required for residue ", residue_type, "."))}
    stage3a_z
  }

# Return bootstrap location statistics L_b^*(d) for given d-value and residue_type by extract_bootstrap_location()
  extract_bootstrap_location <- function(fit, residue_type,  d_value) {
    bootstrap_location <- fit$bootstrap_statistics_L
    if (is.null(bootstrap_location)) {stop( paste0("bootstrap_statistics_L was not returned by ","d_ccssbu_l() for residue ", residue_type," and d = ", d_value,". Run d_ccssbu_l() with ", "keep_bootstrap_statistics = TRUE." ))}
    bootstrap_location <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(bootstrap_location))
    bootstrap_location <- bootstrap_location[!is.na(bootstrap_location) & is.finite(bootstrap_location)]
    if (length(bootstrap_location) == 0) {stop(paste0("No finite bootstrap location statistics were found ", "for residue ", residue_type," and d = ", d_value,"."))}
    bootstrap_location
  }

# Return q by extract_q()
  extract_q <- function(fit,residue_type) {
    q_value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(fit$q))
    if (length(q_value) != 1 ||is.na(q_value) ||!is.finite(q_value) ||q_value < 1) {stop(paste0("A valid q value was not returned by d_ccssbu_l() ","for residue ", residue_type,".")) }
    q_integer <- as.integer(round(q_value))
    if (abs(q_value - q_integer) >comparison_tolerance) {stop(paste0("The returned q value is not an integer for residue ",residue_type,"."))}
    q_integer
  }

# Extract chart limits CL or UCL by the argument limit_type
  extract_chart_limit <- function(fit,limit_type, residue_type, d_value ) {
    if (identical(limit_type, "CL")){limit_value <- fit$CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot} 
    else if (identical(limit_type, "UCL")) {limit_value <- fit$UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot} 
    else {stop("limit_type must be either CL or UCL.")}
    limit_value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(limit_value))
    if (length(limit_value) != 1 ||is.na(limit_value) ||!is.finite(limit_value)) {
      stop(paste0("A finite ",limit_type," was not returned for residue ",residue_type," and d = ", d_value,"."))}
    limit_value
  }
  
# Extract calibration information: nzchar() nonzero character, trimws() remove white space of both sides
  
   # 1) Extract calibration case (5 cases as in step 9 in d-ccssbu-l algorithm)
  extract_calibration_case <- function( fit,residue_type,d_value) {
    calibration_case <- as.character(fit$case_label)
    calibration_case <- calibration_case[!is.na(calibration_case) & nzchar(trimws(calibration_case))]
    if (length(calibration_case) == 0) {stop(paste0("case_label was not returned for residue ",residue_type," and d = ",d_value,"."))}
    calibration_case[[1]]
  }

   # 2) Extract n_cal
  extract_n_cal <- function(fit,residue_type, d_value) {
    n_cal <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(fit$n_Cal))
    if (length(n_cal) != 1 || is.na(n_cal) ||!is.finite(n_cal) || n_cal < 1) {stop(paste0("A valid n_Cal value was not returned for residue ",residue_type," and d = ",d_value,"." ))}
    n_cal_integer <- as.integer(round(n_cal))
    if (abs(n_cal - n_cal_integer) >comparison_tolerance) {stop(paste0("n_Cal is not an integer for residue ", residue_type," and d = ", d_value,"." ))}
    n_cal_integer
  }

   #3) Extract OOC counts in three periods to define D1, D2
  extract_ooc_counts <- function( fit, residue_type, d_value) {
    
    validate_ooc_count <- function( value, value_name) {
      value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(value))
      if (length(value) != 1 ||is.na(value) ||!is.finite(value) ||value < 0) {
        stop(paste0("A valid ", value_name," was not returned for residue ", residue_type," and d = ", d_value,"."))}
      value_integer <- as.integer(round(value))
      if (abs(value - value_integer) >comparison_tolerance) {
        stop(paste0(value_name," is not an integer for residue ", residue_type," and d = ", d_value,"."))}
      value_integer
    }
    
    list(OOC_ND = validate_ooc_count(fit$n_ND_ooc,"n_ND_ooc"),
         OOC_3A = validate_ooc_count(fit$n_stage3A_ooc,"n_stage3A_ooc"), 
         OOC_3B = validate_ooc_count(fit$n_stage3B_ooc,"n_stage3B_ooc"))
  }

# Xbar-chart ARL1 benchmark IC model: Z ~ N(mu_0, sigma_Z^2)
# OC model: Z ~ N(mu_0 + rho * sigma_Z, sigma_Z^2)
# Retrun ARL_1 =1/p1_rbar
    conventional_xbar_chart_arl1 <- function(rho, mu_0, sigma_Z, n, alpha) {

    if (length(rho) != 1 ||is.na(rho) ||!is.finite(rho) ||rho < 0) {return(NA_real_)}
    if (length(mu_0) != 1 ||is.na(mu_0) ||!is.finite(mu_0)) {return(NA_real_)}
    if (length(sigma_Z) != 1 || is.na(sigma_Z) || !is.finite(sigma_Z) ||sigma_Z <= 0) {return(NA_real_)}
    if (length(n) != 1 || !is.finite(n) ||n < 1) {return(NA_real_)}
    n <- as.integer(round(n))
    mu_1 <- mu_0 +rho * sigma_Z
    xbar_standard_error <- sigma_Z /sqrt(n)
    UCL_xbar <- mu_0 +stats::qnorm(1 - alpha) * xbar_standard_error
    p1_xbar <- stats::pnorm(q = UCL_xbar, mean = mu_1, sd = xbar_standard_error, lower.tail = FALSE)
    if (is.na(p1_xbar)) {return(NA_real_)}
    if (p1_xbar <= 0) {return(Inf)}
    1/p1_xbar
  }

# Determine benchmark subgroup size
  get_benchmark_n <- function(residue_type, residue_position, event_statistics) {
    
    if (is.null(benchmark_n)) {
      n_col <- first_existing_name(event_statistics, c("n_locations_observed","n_locations","n_sampling_locations","subgroup_size"))
      if (is.null(n_col)) {stop(paste0("No observed number-of-locations column was found ","for residue ",residue_type,". Provide benchmark_n explicitly."))}
      observed_n <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(event_statistics[[n_col]]))
      observed_n <- observed_n[!is.na(observed_n) & is.finite(observed_n) & observed_n >= 1]
      if (length(observed_n) == 0) {stop(paste0("No finite positive subgroup sizes were found for ","residue ", residue_type, "."))}
      benchmark_n_i <- as.integer(round(stats::median(observed_n)))
    } else if (!is.null(names(benchmark_n)) && residue_type %in% names(benchmark_n)){
      benchmark_n_i <- as.integer(benchmark_n[[residue_type]])
    } else if (length(benchmark_n) == 1) {benchmark_n_i <- as.integer(benchmark_n[[1]])
    } else if (length(benchmark_n) ==length(residue_types)) {benchmark_n_i <- as.integer(benchmark_n[[residue_position]])
    } else {stop(paste0("benchmark_n must be NULL, one number, a named ","vector by residue type, or a vector having the ","same length as residue_types."))}
    if (length(benchmark_n_i) != 1 ||is.na(benchmark_n_i) ||!is.finite(benchmark_n_i) ||benchmark_n_i < 1) {
      stop(paste0("The Xbar-chart benchmark requires benchmark_n >= 1 ","for residue ",residue_type,"."))}
    benchmark_n_i
  }

# Recommend d for one residue type (main function)
  recommend_d_for_residue <- function(candidate_tbl) {
    required_columns <- c("Residue","d","q","OOC_ND","OOC_3A","OOC_3B", "rho","ARL1", "Xbar_chart_ARL1" )
    missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns,names(candidate_tbl))
    if (length(missing_columns)>0){stop(paste0("The recommendation input is missing column(s): ",paste(missing_columns,collapse=", ")))}
    residue_values <- unique(as.character(candidate_tbl$Residue))
    residue_values <- residue_values[!is.na(residue_values) & nzchar(trimws(residue_values))]
    if (length(residue_values) != 1) {stop("recommend_d_for_residue() requires one residue type.")}
    residue_i <- residue_values[[1]]
    q_values <- unique(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(candidate_tbl$q)))
    q_values <- q_values[!is.na(q_values) & is.finite(q_values)]
    if (length(q_values) != 1) {stop(paste0("Exactly one finite q value is required for residue ",residue_i,"."))}
    q_i <- as.integer(round(q_values[[1]]))
    candidate_values <- sort(unique(suppressWarnings(as.integer(candidate_tbl$d))))
    candidate_values <- candidate_values[!is.na(candidate_values)]
    expected_candidates <- seq_len(q_i)
    if (!identical(candidate_values,expected_candidates)) {stop(paste0("The candidate set for residue ",residue_i," must be d = 1, 2, ..., q."))}
    expected_grid <- rho_grid
    grid_check <- candidate_tbl |>dplyr::count(.data$d,.data$rho, name = "n_rows")
    if (any(grid_check$n_rows != 1)) {stop(paste0("At least one residue-d-rho combination has ","duplicate rows for residue ",residue_i,"."))}
    for (d_i in candidate_values) {
      observed_grid_i <- candidate_tbl |>dplyr::filter(.data$d == d_i) |> dplyr::pull(.data$rho)
      observed_grid_i <- sort(unique(as.numeric(observed_grid_i)))
      if (length(observed_grid_i) !=length(expected_grid) ||any(abs(observed_grid_i -expected_grid) > comparison_tolerance)) {
        stop(paste0("Candidate d = ",d_i," for residue ", residue_i," does not contain the complete rho grid."))}
    }
    candidate_metrics <- candidate_tbl |> 
      dplyr::mutate(R =.data$ARL1 /.data$Xbar_chart_ARL1) |>
      dplyr::group_by(.data$Residue,.data$d,.data$q) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        OOC_ND =dplyr::first(.data$OOC_ND),
        OOC_3A =dplyr::first(.data$OOC_3A),
        OOC_3B =dplyr::first(.data$OOC_3B),
        all_R_valid = all(!is.na(.data$R) & is.finite(.data$R) &.data$R > 0),
        W = if (all(!is.na(.data$R) & is.finite(.data$R) & .data$R > 0)){max(.data$R)} else {NA_real_},
        G = if (all(!is.na(.data$R) & is.finite(.data$R) & .data$R > 0)) {exp(mean(log(.data$R)))} else {NA_real_},
        .groups = "drop")|>dplyr::arrange(.data$d)
    
    if (any(!candidate_metrics$all_R_valid) ||anyNA(candidate_metrics$W) ||anyNA(candidate_metrics$G)) {
      stop(paste0("At least one relative ARL curve is invalid for ","residue ",residue_i,"."))}
    C_d <- sort(unique(candidate_metrics$d))
    D1 <- candidate_metrics |>dplyr::filter(.data$OOC_ND == 0) |>dplyr::pull(.data$d) |>unique() |>sort()
    D2 <- candidate_metrics |>dplyr::filter(.data$OOC_3A == 0) |>dplyr::pull(.data$d) |> unique() |> sort()
    D12 <- sort(intersect(D1,D2))
    if (length(D12) > 0){
      observed_behavior_case <-"D1_intersect_D2"
      A <- D12} 
    else if (length(D1) > 0){
      observed_behavior_case <- "D1"
      A <- D1} 
    else if (length(D2) > 0){
      observed_behavior_case <- "D2"
      A <- D2} 
    else {
      observed_behavior_case <- "C_d"
      A <- C_d}
    metrics_A <- candidate_metrics |> dplyr::filter(.data$d %in% A) |>dplyr::arrange(.data$d)
    U <- metrics_A |>dplyr::filter(.data$W <=1 + comparison_tolerance) |> dplyr::pull(.data$d) |>unique() |>sort()
    tied_W_d <- integer(0)
    tied_G_d <- integer(0)
    minimum_W <- NA_real_
    minimum_G <- NA_real_
    
    if (length(U) > 0) {
      arl_curve_case <- "U"
      d_rec <- as.integer(max(U))
      selection_rule <-"U case: maximum d in U according to Rule 3"
    } else {arl_curve_case <- "XO"
      minimum_W <- min(metrics_A$W)
      tied_W_d <- metrics_A |>dplyr::filter(values_tied(.data$W,minimum_W)) |>dplyr::pull(.data$d) |> unique() |> sort()
      metrics_W_tie <- metrics_A |>dplyr::filter(.data$d %in% tied_W_d )
      minimum_G <- min( metrics_W_tie$G )
      tied_G_d <- metrics_W_tie |>dplyr::filter(values_tied(.data$G,minimum_G)) |>dplyr::pull(.data$d) |> unique() |> sort()
      d_rec <- as.integer(max(tied_G_d))
      selection_rule <- paste0("XO case: minimum W over A; minimum G among ","candidates tied on W; maximum d if a tie remains ", 
                               "according to Rule 3" )
      }
    selected_metrics <- metrics_A |>dplyr::filter(.data$d == d_rec)
    selected_W <- selected_metrics$W[[1]]
    selected_G <- selected_metrics$G[[1]]
    case_key <- paste(observed_behavior_case, arl_curve_case,sep = "|")
    case_lookup <- c(
      "D1_intersect_D2|U" = "Case 1",
      "D1_intersect_D2|XO" = "Case 2",
      "D1|U" = "Case 3",
      "D1|XO" = "Case 4",
      "D2|U" = "Case 5",
      "D2|XO" = "Case 6",
      "C_d|U" = "Case 7",
      "C_d|XO" = "Case 8"
    )
    selected_case <- unname(case_lookup[case_key] )
    notes <- character(0)
    if (length(D1) == 0) {notes <- c(notes, paste0("D1 is empty: every candidate d flagged at least ","one ND event as OOC."))}
    if (length(D2) == 0) {notes <- c(notes, paste0("D2 is empty: every candidate d flagged at least ","one nominal Stage 3A event as OOC."))}
    if (length(U) == 0) { notes <- c(notes, paste0("U is empty: every candidate in A has at least one ",
                                                   "rho value for which its d-CCSSBU-L ARL1 exceeds ","the corresponding Xbar-chart ARL1 benchmark."))}
    if (arl_curve_case == "XO" && length(tied_W_d) > 1) {notes <- c( notes,paste0("Candidate d values ", collapse_set(tied_W_d), 
                                                                                  " attained the same minimum W value.")) }
    if (arl_curve_case == "XO" && length(tied_G_d) > 1) {
      notes <- c( notes,paste0("Candidate d values ", collapse_set(tied_G_d)," remained tied after comparing G. The largest ",
                               "tied value of d was selected according to Rule 3." ))}
    if (arl_curve_case == "U") {notes <- c( notes,paste0("The largest d in U was selected according to ", 
                                                         "Rule 3 because every candidate in U has an ARL1 ", 
                                                         "curve that remains below or touches the Xbar-chart ",
                                                         "benchmark throughout the complete rho grid." ))}

    recommendation_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
      Residue = residue_i,
      recommended_d = d_rec,
      q = q_i,
      observed_behavior_case =observed_behavior_case,
      arl_curve_case = arl_curve_case,
      selected_case = selected_case,
      selection_rule = selection_rule,
      C_d_values = collapse_set(C_d),
      D1_values = collapse_set(D1),
      D2_values = collapse_set(D2),
      A_values = collapse_set(A),
      U_values = collapse_set(U),
      W_tied_d_values = collapse_set(tied_W_d),
      G_tied_d_values = collapse_set(tied_G_d),
      minimum_W = minimum_W,
      minimum_G_among_W_ties =  minimum_G,
      recommended_W = selected_W,
      recommended_G = selected_G,
      selection_path = paste(selected_case, observed_behavior_case, arl_curve_case, selection_rule, sep = " | " ),
      recommendation_notes = paste(notes, collapse = " | "))

    candidate_metrics_output <- candidate_metrics |>
      dplyr::mutate(in_C_d =.data$d %in% C_d,
        in_D1 =   .data$d %in% D1,
        in_D2 =   .data$d %in% D2,
        in_A =  .data$d %in% A,
        in_U =  .data$d %in% U,
        selected =.data$d == d_rec)

    list(recommendation = recommendation_tbl,
      candidate_metrics =candidate_metrics_output)
  }

# Fit all residues and candidate d values
  all_rows <- list() #store every candidate-specific long-format ARL1 table.
  all_fit_objects <- list() #store every full result returned by d_ccssbu_l()
  all_candidate_information <- list() #store selected detailed information for each residue-d fit.
  all_benchmark_models <- list() # store one X_bar benchmark model per residue
  row_id <- 1L
  fit_id <- 1L
# treat every resideue type DAR, CAR, and Mic
  for (rr in seq_along(residue_types)) {
    residue_type_i <- as.character(residue_types[[rr]])
    sheet_i <- sheets[[rr]]
    if (isTRUE(verbose)) {message("Processing residue type: ",residue_type_i," | sheet: ",sheet_i)}
# Step 1. Initial d = 1 fit to determine q
    fit_q <- d_ccssbu_l(
      file = file,
      equipment_label = equipment_label,
      residue_type = residue_type_i,
      sheet = sheet_i,
      d = 1,
      n_stage3A_events =  n_stage3A_events,
      target_ARL0 =   target_ARL0,
      B = B,
      c_smooth = c_smooth,
      h_min = h_min,
      seed =seed + 1000L * rr + 1L,
      location_eligibility_threshold =location_eligibility_threshold,
      location_distinct_digits =location_distinct_digits,
      cluster_col = cluster_col,
      cluster_group_cols =cluster_group_cols,
      cluster_round_digits =cluster_round_digits,
      event_col = event_col,
      location_col = location_col,
      result_col = result_col,
      lod_col = lod_col,
      loq_col = loq_col,
      usl_col = usl_col,
      plot_chart = FALSE,
      save_outputs = FALSE,
      return_bootstrap_matrix = FALSE,
      keep_bootstrap_statistics = TRUE)
    
    event_statistics_q <- extract_event_statistics(fit = fit_q, residue_type = residue_type_i,d_value = 1 ) #event-level chart statistics for d=1.
    q_residue <- extract_q(fit = fit_q, residue_type = residue_type_i) #Extracts the residue-specific value of q.
# Step 2. Construct benchmark model once per residue type
    stage3a_z_i <- extract_stage3a_z( fit = fit_q, residue_type = residue_type_i )
    mu_0_i <- mean( stage3a_z_i)
    s_Z_i <- stats::sd(stage3a_z_i)
    if (is.na(mu_0_i) ||!is.finite(mu_0_i)) {stop( paste0("The Stage 3A mean could not be calculated for ","residue ", residue_type_i,"."))}
    if (is.na(s_Z_i) ||!is.finite(s_Z_i) ||s_Z_i < 0) {stop(paste0("The Stage 3A empirical standard deviation could ",
                                                                   "not be calculated for residue ", residue_type_i,"."  ))}
    sigma_Z_i <- max( s_Z_i,h_min )
    if (!is.finite(sigma_Z_i) ||sigma_Z_i <= 0) {stop(paste0("sigma_Z must be positive for residue ",residue_type_i,"."))}
    benchmark_n_i <- get_benchmark_n( residue_type = residue_type_i,residue_position = rr,event_statistics =  event_statistics_q  )
    additive_shift_i <-  rho_grid * sigma_Z_i
    mu_1_i <- mu_0_i + additive_shift_i
    UCL_Xbar_i <-  mu_0_i + z_limit * sigma_Z_i /sqrt(benchmark_n_i)
    xbar_benchmark_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
      rho = rho_grid,
      additive_shift =additive_shift_i,
      mu_0 = mu_0_i,
      s_Z = s_Z_i,
      sigma_Z = sigma_Z_i,
      mu_1 = mu_1_i,
      UCL_Xbar = UCL_Xbar_i,
      Xbar_chart_ARL1 = vapply(rho_grid,conventional_xbar_chart_arl1,mu_0 = mu_0_i,sigma_Z = sigma_Z_i,
                               n = benchmark_n_i,alpha = alpha,FUN.VALUE = numeric(1)))
    all_benchmark_models[[residue_type_i]] <- list(
        Residue = residue_type_i,
        stage3a_z = stage3a_z_i,
        mu_0 = mu_0_i,
        s_Z = s_Z_i,
        sigma_Z = sigma_Z_i,
        h_min = h_min,
        benchmark_n = benchmark_n_i,
        rho_grid = rho_grid,
        additive_shift =  additive_shift_i,
        mu_1 = mu_1_i,
        UCL_Xbar = UCL_Xbar_i,
        benchmark_table = xbar_benchmark_tbl
      )
    if (isTRUE(verbose)) {message("  q = ", q_residue," | benchmark n = ",benchmark_n_i," | mu_0 = ", signif(mu_0_i, 6)," | s_Z = ",
                                  signif(s_Z_i, 6), " | sigma_Z = ",  signif(sigma_Z_i, 6)) }
    
# Fit d = 1, 2, ..., q
    for (d_i in seq_len(q_residue)) {
      if (isTRUE(verbose)) {message("  Fitting d = ",  d_i, " of ",  q_residue  )}
      if (d_i == 1L) {fit_i <- fit_q
      }else {
        fit_i <- d_ccssbu_l(
          file = file,
          equipment_label = equipment_label,
          residue_type =  residue_type_i,
          sheet = sheet_i,
          d = d_i,
          n_stage3A_events =n_stage3A_events,
          target_ARL0 =  target_ARL0,
          B = B,
          c_smooth =c_smooth,
          h_min =  h_min,
          seed =  seed + 1000L * rr + d_i,
          location_eligibility_threshold =location_eligibility_threshold,
          location_distinct_digits =location_distinct_digits,
          cluster_col =  cluster_col,
          cluster_group_cols =  cluster_group_cols,
          cluster_round_digits =cluster_round_digits,
          event_col = event_col,
          location_col = location_col,
          result_col = result_col,
          lod_col = lod_col,
          loq_col = loq_col,
          usl_col = usl_col,
          plot_chart = FALSE,
          save_outputs = FALSE,
          return_bootstrap_matrix =  FALSE,
          keep_bootstrap_statistics = TRUE)
       } #fit_i
      event_statistics_i <- extract_event_statistics(fit = fit_i,residue_type = residue_type_i, d_value = d_i )
      CL_i <- extract_chart_limit(fit = fit_i,limit_type = "CL",residue_type = residue_type_i,d_value = d_i )
      UCL_i <- extract_chart_limit(fit = fit_i,limit_type = "UCL",residue_type = residue_type_i,d_value = d_i)
      calibration_case_i <- extract_calibration_case(fit = fit_i, residue_type = residue_type_i,d_value = d_i)
      n_cal_i <- extract_n_cal(fit = fit_i,residue_type = residue_type_i,d_value = d_i)
      ooc_counts_i <- extract_ooc_counts(fit = fit_i, residue_type = residue_type_i,  d_value = d_i  )
      bootstrap_location_i <- extract_bootstrap_location( fit = fit_i,residue_type = residue_type_i,d_value = d_i)
      n_bootstrap_i <- length(bootstrap_location_i)

# Step 3. Apply rho * sigma_Z to L_b^*(d)
      n_signals_i <- vapply(additive_shift_i, function(additive_shift){sum(bootstrap_location_i+additive_shift >UCL_i,  na.rm = TRUE)},        FUN.VALUE = integer(1))
      p1_i <- n_signals_i /n_bootstrap_i # n_bootstrap_i is in fact B from the function definition
      ARL1_uncensored_i <- ifelse(p1_i > 0, 1 / p1_i, Inf )
      ARL1_i <- pmin(ARL1_uncensored_i, T_max) # if ARL1_ncensored_i>T_max, then it is already a warning.
      ARL1_censored_i <-!is.finite(ARL1_uncensored_i) | ARL1_uncensored_i > T_max
      candidate_shift_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
        rho = rho_grid,
        additive_shift =additive_shift_i,
        mu_0 = mu_0_i,
        s_Z = s_Z_i,
        sigma_Z = sigma_Z_i,
        mu_1 = mu_1_i,
        n_bootstrap = n_bootstrap_i,
        n_signals =  n_signals_i,
        p1 =  p1_i,
        ARL1_uncensored =  ARL1_uncensored_i,
        ARL1 =ARL1_i,
        ARL1_censored = ARL1_censored_i
      )

# Optional IC calibration check at rho = 0
      p0_hat_i <- mean(bootstrap_location_i >UCL_i,na.rm = TRUE)
      ARL0_hat_uncensored_i <- if ( p0_hat_i > 0){1/p0_hat_i} else {Inf}
      ARL0_hat_i <- min(ARL0_hat_uncensored_i,T_max)
      ARL0_censored_i <-!is.finite(ARL0_hat_uncensored_i) ||ARL0_hat_uncensored_i > T_max

# Step 4. Add Xbar benchmark under same shift
      candidate_rows_i <- candidate_shift_tbl |>
        dplyr::left_join(xbar_benchmark_tbl|>dplyr::select(.data$rho,.data$UCL_Xbar,.data$Xbar_chart_ARL1),by = "rho")|>
        dplyr::mutate(Equipment =  equipment_label,
          Residue =  residue_type_i,
          sheet =   as.character(sheet_i),
          d =  as.integer(d_i),
          q = as.integer(q_residue),
          calibration_case =calibration_case_i,
          nCal =as.integer(n_cal_i),
          OOC_ND =  as.integer(ooc_counts_i$OOC_ND),
          OOC_3A =  as.integer(ooc_counts_i$OOC_3A),
          OOC_3B =as.integer(ooc_counts_i$OOC_3B),
          benchmark_n = as.integer(benchmark_n_i),
          target_ARL0 =  target_ARL0,
          alpha =   alpha,
          z_limit =   z_limit,
          CL =  CL_i,
          UCL =  UCL_i,
          p0_hat =  p0_hat_i,
          ARL0_hat_uncensored =   ARL0_hat_uncensored_i,
          ARL0_hat =ARL0_hat_i,
          ARL0_censored =   ARL0_censored_i,
          T_max =  T_max,
          .before = 1 )|>
        dplyr::mutate(relative_ARL_ratio =.data$ARL1/.data$Xbar_chart_ARL1)

      all_rows[[row_id]] <-   candidate_rows_i
      fit_object_name <- paste0(residue_type_i, "_d",   d_i  )
      all_fit_objects[[fit_id]] <-  fit_i
      names(all_fit_objects)[[fit_id]] <- fit_object_name
      all_candidate_information[[fit_id]] <-  list(
          Residue =       residue_type_i,
          d =        as.integer(d_i),
          q =       as.integer(q_residue),
          mu_0 =  mu_0_i,
          s_Z =     s_Z_i,
          sigma_Z =     sigma_Z_i,
          stage3a_z =      stage3a_z_i,
          rho_grid =  rho_grid,
          additive_shift =additive_shift_i,
          calibration_case =calibration_case_i,
          nCal =as.integer(n_cal_i),
          calibration_data =fit_i$calibration_data,
          calibration_status =fit_i$cluster_calibration_status,
          CL =CL_i,
          UCL = UCL_i,
          OOC_ND =as.integer(ooc_counts_i$OOC_ND),
          OOC_3A =as.integer(ooc_counts_i$OOC_3A),
          OOC_3B =  as.integer(ooc_counts_i$OOC_3B),
          benchmark_n = as.integer(benchmark_n_i),
          UCL_Xbar =  UCL_Xbar_i,
          bootstrap_location_statistics =  bootstrap_location_i,
          event_statistics =event_statistics_i
        )
      names(all_candidate_information)[[fit_id]] <- fit_object_name
      row_id <- row_id + 1L
      fit_id <- fit_id + 1L
    } # for loop for d_i done
  } # for loop of rr done
  
  if (length(all_rows) == 0) {stop("No candidate-specific ARL1 results were generated.")}

  # Combine results
  arl1_long_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows( all_rows) |>dplyr::arrange( match(.data$Residue,  residue_types ),.data$d,.data$rho )
  arl1_split <- split(arl1_long_tbl,  factor(arl1_long_tbl$Residue,levels = residue_types), drop = TRUE)
  recommendation_outputs <- lapply(  arl1_split,recommend_d_for_residue )

  recommendation_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply( recommendation_outputs,function(x) {x$recommendation}))|>
    dplyr::arrange(match( .data$Residue,  residue_types))

  candidate_metrics_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply( recommendation_outputs, function(x){x$candidate_metrics}))|>
    dplyr::arrange(  match(.data$Residue,residue_types ),.data$d)

  arl1_long_tbl <- arl1_long_tbl |>
    dplyr::left_join(candidate_metrics_tbl |>
        dplyr::select(.data$Residue,
          .data$d,
          .data$W,
          .data$G,
          .data$in_C_d,
          .data$in_D1,
          .data$in_D2,
          .data$in_A,
          .data$in_U,
          .data$selected),by = c( "Residue","d")) |>
    dplyr::left_join( recommendation_tbl |>
        dplyr::select(
          .data$Residue,
          .data$recommended_d,
          .data$observed_behavior_case,
          .data$arl_curve_case,
          .data$selected_case,
          .data$selection_rule,
          .data$A_values,
          .data$U_values,
          .data$selection_path,
          .data$recommendation_notes),by = "Residue") |>
    dplyr::arrange( match(.data$Residue,residue_types ),.data$d,.data$rho)

  # Construct compact wide ARL1 table using rho
  make_rho_label <- function(x) {
    x_formatted <- format(x,scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE,digits = 15)
    x_formatted <- sub("0+$","",x_formatted)
    x_formatted <- sub("\\.$","",x_formatted)
    gsub("\\.", "p",x_formatted)
  }

  arl1_wide_tbl <- arl1_long_tbl |>
    dplyr::mutate(rho_label =make_rho_label(.data$rho)) |>
    dplyr::select(.data$Residue,.data$d,.data$q,.data$calibration_case,
      .data$nCal,.data$OOC_ND,.data$OOC_3A,.data$OOC_3B,.data$benchmark_n,
      .data$mu_0, .data$s_Z,.data$sigma_Z,.data$CL, .data$UCL,
      .data$W,.data$G,.data$in_A, .data$in_U, .data$selected,
      .data$recommended_d,.data$rho_label,.data$additive_shift, .data$Xbar_chart_ARL1,.data$ARL1) |>
    dplyr::distinct() |>tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c("Residue","d","q","calibration_case","nCal","OOC_ND", "OOC_3A", "OOC_3B","benchmark_n",
                  "mu_0",  "s_Z", "sigma_Z","CL", "UCL","W",  "G","in_A", "in_U", "selected","recommended_d"),
      names_from =  .data$rho_label,
      values_from = c(.data$additive_shift, .data$Xbar_chart_ARL1,.data$ARL1),
      names_glue ="{.value}_rho_{rho_label}") |>dplyr::arrange(match(.data$Residue,residue_types),.data$d )
  
 # Extract recommended d values
  recommended_d_named <- stats::setNames(as.integer(recommendation_tbl$recommended_d),recommendation_tbl$Residue)

  DAR_d <- if ("DAR" %in% names(recommended_d_named)) {as.integer(recommended_d_named[["DAR"]])} else {NA_integer_}
  CAR_d <- if ("CAR" %in% names(recommended_d_named)) {as.integer(recommended_d_named[["CAR"]])} else {NA_integer_}
  Mic_d <- if ("Mic" %in% names(recommended_d_named)) {as.integer(recommended_d_named[["Mic"]])} else {NA_integer_}

  # Rounded display versions
  round_numeric_columns <- function(tbl) {
    numeric_columns <- names(tbl)[vapply(tbl,is.numeric,FUN.VALUE = logical(1))]
    tbl |>dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(numeric_columns), ~ round(.x,digits = round_digits)))
  }
  long_display_tbl <- round_numeric_columns(arl1_long_tbl)
  recommendation_display_tbl <- round_numeric_columns(recommendation_tbl)
  candidate_metrics_display_tbl <-round_numeric_columns(candidate_metrics_tbl)

  # Completion messages
  if (isTRUE(verbose)) {
    message("Completed d-CCSSBU-L d selection.")
    for (ii in seq_len(nrow(recommendation_tbl))) {
      message("  ", recommendation_tbl$Residue[[ii]], ": recommended d = ",recommendation_tbl$recommended_d[[ii]], " | ",        recommendation_tbl$selected_case[[ii]], " | ",recommendation_tbl$arl_curve_case[[ii]])
      }
    }
  
# Return all results
  return(list(recommendations = recommendation_tbl,
      recommendations_display =recommendation_display_tbl,
      recommended_d = recommended_d_named,
      DAR_d = DAR_d,
      CAR_d = CAR_d,
      Mic_d = Mic_d,
      candidate_metrics = candidate_metrics_tbl,
      candidate_metrics_display = candidate_metrics_display_tbl,
      arl1_long =arl1_long_tbl,
      arl1_long_display = long_display_tbl,
      arl1_wide = arl1_wide_tbl,
      benchmark_models =all_benchmark_models,
      fit_objects = all_fit_objects,
      candidate_information =all_candidate_information,
      benchmark_settings = 
        list(target_ARL0 =target_ARL0,alpha=alpha, z_limit=z_limit,rho_grid=rho_grid,benchmark_n=benchmark_n,h_min=h_min,T_max=T_max),
      call =match.call()))
}
```

```{r render_d_ccssbu_l_arl1_tbl_function}
#| echo: false

# use tbl to make a tibble which can automatically shrinkable according to the width of a page
render_d_ccssbu_l_arl1_tbl <- function(
  tbl,
  caption = paste0("d-CCSSBU-L and conventional Xbar-chart ARL1 results ","over the additive location-shift grid."),
  label = NULL,
  font_size = 7){
  if (!is.data.frame(tbl)) {stop("tbl must be a data frame.")}
  if (nrow(tbl) == 0) {stop("tbl contains no rows.")}
  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
    table_output <- tbl %>%
      knitr::kable(format = "latex",booktabs = TRUE,digits = 4, caption = caption,label = label,escape = TRUE) %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "hold_position"), position = "center",font_size = font_size)
  } else {
    table_output <- tbl %>%
      knitr::kable(digits = 4,caption = caption,escape = TRUE) %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","condensed","hover","responsive"),full_width = FALSE)}

  cat(as.character(table_output),"\n")
  invisible(tbl)
}
```

```{r render_d_ccssbu_l_recommendation_tbl_function}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
render_d_ccssbu_l_recommendation_tbl <- function(
  tbl,
  caption = paste0("Recommended d values for the d-CCSSBU-L chart ","under the eight-case selection procedure."),
  label = NULL,
  font_size = 7,
  show_notes = FALSE
) {
  if (!is.data.frame(tbl)) {stop("tbl must be a data frame.")}

  if (nrow(tbl) == 0) {stop("tbl contains no rows.")}

  required_columns <- c(
    "Residue",
    "recommended_d",
    "q",
    "observed_behavior_case",
    "arl_curve_case",
    "selected_case",
    "selection_rule",
    "A_values",
    "U_values",
    "recommended_W",
    "recommended_G",
    "recommendation_notes"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns,names(tbl))

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop("The following required column(s) are missing from tbl: ", paste(missing_columns,collapse = ", "))
  }

  escape_latex_text <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x[is.na(x)] <- ""
    placeholder <- "BACKSLASHPLACEHOLDER"
    x <- gsub("\\\\",  placeholder, x )
    x <- gsub("([#$%&_{}])","\\\\\\1",  x,perl = TRUE )
    x <- gsub("~","\\\\textasciitilde{}",x,fixed = TRUE)
    x <- gsub("^","\\\\textasciicircum{}",x,fixed = TRUE)
    x <- gsub(placeholder,"\\\\textbackslash{}",x,fixed = TRUE)
    x }

  format_set <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x[is.na(x)] <- ""
    ifelse( nzchar(trimws(x)),paste0("{", x,"}" ),"Empty")
  }

  display_observed_case <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    dplyr::case_when(
      x == "D1_intersect_D2" ~ "D1 intersection D2",
      x == "D1" ~ "D1",
      x == "D2" ~ "D2",
      x == "C_d" ~ "C_d",
      TRUE ~ x)
  }

  tbl_display <- tbl %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Residue =   as.character(Residue),
      `Recommended d` =  recommended_d,
      q =  q,
      `Decision case` =  as.character(selected_case),
      `Observed-behavior case` =display_observed_case(observed_behavior_case),
      `ARL1 case` =  as.character(arl_curve_case),
      A =  format_set(A_values),
      U =  format_set(U_values),
      `W(d)` =  recommended_W,
      `G(d)` =  recommended_G,
      `Selection rule` =as.character(selection_rule)
    )

  notes_tbl <- tbl %>%
    dplyr::transmute( Residue = as.character(Residue),Note =as.character(recommendation_notes)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Note),  nzchar(trimws(Note)))

  alignment <- c("l", "c","c","c","l","c","l","l","c","c","l" )

  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
    table_output <- tbl_display %>%
      knitr::kable(format = "latex",  booktabs = TRUE,digits = 4, caption = caption,label = label,escape = TRUE,align = alignment) %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "hold_position"), position = "center",font_size = font_size )
    cat(as.character(table_output), "\n")
    if (isTRUE(show_notes) && nrow(notes_tbl) > 0) {
      cat("\\vspace{1mm}\n")
      cat("\\begin{minipage}{0.96\\textwidth}\n")
      cat("\\footnotesize\n")
      cat("\\noindent\\textit{Notes.}\n")
      cat("\\begin{description}\n")
      cat("\\setlength{\\itemsep}{1pt}\n")
      cat("\\setlength{\\parskip}{0pt}\n")
      cat("\\setlength{\\parsep}{0pt}\n")
      cat("\\setlength{\\topsep}{2pt}\n")
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(notes_tbl))) {
        residue_i <- escape_latex_text(notes_tbl$Residue[[i]])
        note_i <- escape_latex_text(notes_tbl$Note[[i]])
        cat(paste0("\\item[\\textit{",residue_i,":}] ", note_i,"\n"))
      }
      cat("\\end{description}\n")
      cat("\\end{minipage}\n")
      cat("\n")
    }
  } else {
    table_output <- tbl_display %>%
      knitr::kable(digits = 4,caption = caption,escape = TRUE,align = alignment) %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","condensed","hover","responsive"),full_width = FALSE)

    cat(  as.character(table_output),  "\n"  )
    if (isTRUE(show_notes) && nrow(notes_tbl) > 0) {
      cat("\n\n*Notes.*\n\n")
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(notes_tbl))) {cat(paste0("- *", notes_tbl$Residue[[i]],":* ", notes_tbl$Note[[i]],"\n"))}
      cat("\n")}
  }
  invisible(tbl_display)
}
```

```{r plot-d-ccssbu-l-arl1-curves-function}
#| include: false
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
plot_d_ccssbu_l_arl1_curves <- function(
  tbl,
  equipment_label = "Equipment",
  output_file = NULL,
  residue_order = c("DAR", "CAR", "Mic"),
  width = 9,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 300,
  y_log10 = TRUE,
  show_points = TRUE,
  base_size = 11) {

  # ==========================================================
  # Check required packages
  # ==========================================================

  required_packages <- c("dplyr","ggplot2","patchwork")

  missing_packages <- required_packages[!vapply(required_packages,requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE, FUN.VALUE = logical(1))]

  if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {stop(paste0("Please install the following package(s): ",paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),"."))}

  # ==========================================================
  # Validate inputs
  # ==========================================================

  if (is.null(tbl) || !is.data.frame(tbl) ||nrow(tbl) == 0) {stop( "tbl must be a nonempty data frame.")}
  required_columns <- c("Residue","d","rho","ARL1", "Xbar_chart_ARL1" )
  missing_columns <- setdiff( required_columns, names(tbl))
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {stop(paste0("The following required column(s) are missing: ",paste(  missing_columns,  collapse = ", "), "."))}

  if (length(equipment_label) != 1 || is.na(equipment_label) ||!nzchar(trimws(equipment_label))) {
    stop("equipment_label must be one nonempty character value.")}

  if (length(width) != 1 || is.na(width) || !is.finite(width) ||width <= 0) {stop("width must be a positive finite number.")}
  if (length(height) != 1 ||is.na(height) ||!is.finite(height) || height <= 0) {stop("height must be a positive finite number." )}
  if (length(dpi) != 1 ||is.na(dpi) ||!is.finite(dpi) ||dpi <= 0) {stop("dpi must be a positive finite number.")}
  if (length(base_size) != 1 ||is.na(base_size) ||!is.finite(base_size) ||base_size <= 0) { stop("base_size must be a positive finite number.")}

  residue_order <- unique(as.character(residue_order))

  if (length(residue_order) == 0 || anyNA(residue_order) ||any(!nzchar(trimws(residue_order)))) {
    stop("residue_order must contain nonempty residue names.")}

  # ==========================================================
  # Prepare plotting data
  # ==========================================================

  plot_data <- tbl |>
    dplyr::transmute(Residue = as.character(.data$Residue),
      d = suppressWarnings(as.integer(.data$d)),
      rho = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data$rho)),
      ARL1 = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data$ARL1)),
      Xbar_chart_ARL1 = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data$Xbar_chart_ARL1))) |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$Residue %in% residue_order)

  missing_residues <- setdiff(residue_order,unique(plot_data$Residue))

  if (length(missing_residues) > 0){stop( paste0("The following requested residue type(s) are absent: ",paste(missing_residues, collapse = ", "),"."))}

  invalid_rows <- plot_data |>
    dplyr::filter(
      is.na(.data$d) |.data$d < 1 |is.na(.data$rho) |!is.finite(.data$rho) |.data$rho <= 0 |is.na(.data$ARL1) | .data$ARL1 <= 0 |
        is.na(.data$Xbar_chart_ARL1) |.data$Xbar_chart_ARL1 <= 0)

  if (nrow(invalid_rows) > 0) {stop( paste0("The plotting data contain missing, invalid, or ",
                                            "nonpositive values of d, rho, ARL1, or ","Xbar_chart_ARL1."))}

  duplicate_rows <- plot_data |>
    dplyr::count(.data$Residue,.data$d,.data$rho, name = "n_rows" ) |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$n_rows > 1)

  if (nrow(duplicate_rows) > 0) {stop(paste0("Multiple rows were found for at least one ","Residue, d, and rho combination."))}

  benchmark_check <- plot_data |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$Residue,.data$rho) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n_benchmark_values =dplyr::n_distinct(.data$Xbar_chart_ARL1),.groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$n_benchmark_values > 1)

  if (nrow(benchmark_check) > 0) {stop(paste0("The Xbar-chart ARL1 benchmark varies across d ","for at least one Residue and rho combination."))}

  nonfinite_rows <- plot_data |>dplyr::filter(!is.finite(.data$ARL1) |!is.finite(.data$Xbar_chart_ARL1) )

  if (nrow(nonfinite_rows) > 0) {warning(paste0(nrow(nonfinite_rows)," row(s) with infinite ARL1 values were omitted."), call. = FALSE)}
  plot_data <- plot_data |> dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$ARL1),is.finite(.data$Xbar_chart_ARL1))
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {stop("No finite ARL1 values remain for plotting." ) }
  rho_breaks <- sort( unique(plot_data$rho))

  # ==========================================================
  # Make one plot for one residue type
  # ==========================================================

  make_residue_plot <- function(residue_name) {

    residue_data <- plot_data |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$Residue == residue_name) |>
      dplyr::arrange(.data$d, .data$rho ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(d_label = factor(paste0("d = ", .data$d),levels = paste0("d = ", sort(unique(.data$d)))))

    if (nrow(residue_data) == 0) {stop(paste0("No finite plotting data were found for residue ", residue_name,"."))}

    benchmark_data <- residue_data |>
      dplyr::select(.data$rho,.data$Xbar_chart_ARL1) |>
      dplyr::distinct() |>
      dplyr::arrange(.data$rho)

    residue_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
      ggplot2::geom_line(
        data = residue_data,
        mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = .data$rho, y = .data$ARL1, color = .data$d_label,group = .data$d_label),
        linewidth = 0.85,
        na.rm = TRUE)

    if (isTRUE(show_points)) {
      residue_plot <- residue_plot +
        ggplot2::geom_point(
          data = residue_data,
          mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = .data$rho,y = .data$ARL1,color = .data$d_label,group = .data$d_label),
          size = 1.8,
          na.rm = TRUE)
    }

    residue_plot <- residue_plot +
      ggplot2::geom_line(
        data = benchmark_data,
        mapping = ggplot2::aes( x = .data$rho,y = .data$Xbar_chart_ARL1,linetype = "Xbar-chart ARL1 benchmark", group = 1),
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 1.3,
        na.rm = TRUE) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        data = benchmark_data,
        mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = .data$rho,y = .data$Xbar_chart_ARL1),
        color = "black",
        shape = 18,
        size = 2.7,
        na.rm = TRUE) +
      ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = rho_breaks,
        labels = formatC(rho_breaks,format = "f", digits = 1)) +
      ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual(name = NULL,values = c("Xbar-chart ARL1 benchmark" = "longdash")) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = paste0(residue_name," ARL1 curves"),
        x = expression("Shift multiplier, " * rho),
        y = expression(ARL[1]),
        color = "d-CCSSBU-L candidate") +
      ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = base_size ) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
        panel.grid.minor =ggplot2::element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold")
      )

    if (isTRUE(y_log10)) {residue_plot <- residue_plot +ggplot2::scale_y_log10()}
    residue_plot
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Generate and stack DAR, CAR, and Mic panels
  # ==========================================================

  residue_plots <- lapply(residue_order,make_residue_plot )
  names(residue_plots) <- residue_order
  combined_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(residue_plots, ncol = 1, guides = "collect") +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title = paste0("d-CCSSBU-L and conventional Xbar-chart ", "ARL1 curves for ", equipment_label),
      subtitle = paste0("Candidate curves versus the conventional ","Xbar-chart ARL1 benchmark curve."),
      theme = ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 3,hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size, hjust = 0.5))
    ) & ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "right")

  # ==========================================================
  # Construct the output filename
  # ==========================================================

  if (is.null(output_file)) {
    equipment_file_name <- tolower(trimws(equipment_label))
    equipment_file_name <- gsub(pattern = "[^a-z0-9]+", replacement = "-",  x = equipment_file_name)
    equipment_file_name <- gsub(pattern = "^-+|-+$",replacement = "", x = equipment_file_name )
    output_file <- paste0("d-ccssbu-l-arl1-curves-",equipment_file_name,".png")
  }

  if (length(output_file) != 1 || is.na(output_file) || !nzchar(trimws(output_file))) {
    stop("output_file must be one nonempty character value.") }

  if (!grepl(pattern = "\\.png$",x = output_file,ignore.case = TRUE)) {output_file <- paste0(output_file,".png")}

  # ==========================================================
  # Save the combined figure
  # ==========================================================

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = output_file,
    plot = combined_plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in",
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )

  message(paste0("The ARL1 curve figure was saved to: ",normalizePath(output_file,winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)))

  # ==========================================================
  # Return all plot objects
  # ==========================================================

  invisible(
    list(
      plot = combined_plot,
      panels = residue_plots,
      DAR = residue_plots[["DAR"]],
      CAR = residue_plots[["CAR"]],
      Mic = residue_plots[["Mic"]],
      output_file = output_file,
      plotting_data = plot_data
    )
  )
}
```
