```{r d-ccssbu-s-d-selection-arl1-functions-v6}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

d_ccssbu_s_d_selection_arl1 <- function(
  file,
  equipment_label = "Equipment",
  residue_types = c("DAR", "CAR", "Mic"),
  sheets = residue_types,
  n_stage3A_events = 10,
  target_ARL0 = 740,
  B = 20000,
  c_smooth = 0.5,
  h_min = 0.05,
  seed = 2026,
  scale_eligibility_threshold = 70,
  scale_distinct_digits = 10,
  cluster_col = "USL",
  cluster_group_cols = NULL,
  cluster_round_digits = 10,
  rho_grid = c( 1.05,  1.10,  1.20,   1.50,  2.00,2.25),
  T_max = 10000,
  benchmark_n = NULL,
  event_col = "Event",
  location_col = "Location",
  result_col = "Result",
  lod_col = "LOD",
  loq_col = "LOQ",
  usl_col = "USL",
  comparison_tolerance = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps),
  round_digits = 4,
  verbose = TRUE) {
  required_packages <- c(  "dplyr",   "tibble",   "tidyr"  )
  missing_packages <- required_packages[!vapply(required_packages,requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE, FUN.VALUE = logical(1))]

  if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {stop("Please install the following package(s): ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))}

  if (!exists("d_ccssbu_s", mode = "function")) {stop( paste0("The function d_ccssbu_s() must be defined before ",
        "running d_ccssbu_s_d_selection_arl1()."))}

  # Validate arguments
  if (length(residue_types) != length(sheets)) {stop( "residue_types and sheets must have the same length." ) }
  if (length(residue_types) == 0) {stop("At least one residue type must be supplied." )}
  residue_types <- as.character(residue_types)
  sheets <- as.character(sheets)
  if (anyNA(residue_types) ||any(!nzchar(trimws(residue_types)))) {
    stop("residue_types must contain nonempty character values.") }
  if (anyNA(sheets) ||any(!nzchar(trimws(sheets)))) {stop("sheets must contain nonempty character values.")}

  if (length(n_stage3A_events) != 1 ||
      is.na(n_stage3A_events) ||
      !is.finite(n_stage3A_events) ||
      n_stage3A_events < 1) { stop("n_stage3A_events must be a positive integer."  )}

  n_stage3A_events <- as.integer(round(n_stage3A_events))
  if (length(target_ARL0) != 1 || is.na(target_ARL0) ||!is.finite(target_ARL0) ||target_ARL0 <= 1)
    { stop("target_ARL0 must be a finite number greater than 1.")}
  if (length(B) != 1 ||is.na(B) ||!is.finite(B) ||B <= 0) { stop("B must be a positive finite number.") }
  B <- as.integer(round(B))
  if (length(c_smooth) != 1 ||is.na(c_smooth) ||!is.finite(c_smooth) || c_smooth < 0) 
    {   stop( "c_smooth must be a finite nonnegative number."  )}

  if (length(h_min) != 1 ||is.na(h_min) ||!is.finite(h_min) ||h_min <= 0) {
    stop(paste0( "h_min must be a strictly positive finite number ","for the benchmark model.")) }

  if (length(scale_eligibility_threshold) != 1 ||
      is.na(scale_eligibility_threshold) ||
      !is.finite(scale_eligibility_threshold) ||
      scale_eligibility_threshold <= 0
  ) {stop("scale_eligibility_threshold must be positive.")}

  if (length(scale_distinct_digits) != 1 ||
      is.na(scale_distinct_digits) ||
      !is.finite(scale_distinct_digits) ||
      scale_distinct_digits < 0
  ) { stop("scale_distinct_digits must be a nonnegative integer." )}

  scale_distinct_digits <- as.integer(round(scale_distinct_digits))

  if (length(T_max) != 1 || is.na(T_max) ||!is.finite(T_max) || T_max <= 0) {
    stop("T_max must be a positive finite number.")}

  T_max <- as.numeric(T_max)

  if (length(comparison_tolerance) != 1 ||
      is.na(comparison_tolerance) ||
      !is.finite(comparison_tolerance) ||
      comparison_tolerance < 0
  ) {stop(paste0( "comparison_tolerance must be a finite ", "nonnegative number." ) )}

  if (length(round_digits) != 1 ||
      is.na(round_digits) ||
      !is.finite(round_digits) ||
      round_digits < 0
  ) { stop("round_digits must be a finite nonnegative integer.")}

  round_digits <- as.integer(round(round_digits))

  rho_grid <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(rho_grid))

  if (length(rho_grid) == 0 ||
      anyNA(rho_grid) ||
      any(!is.finite(rho_grid)) ||
      any(rho_grid <= 1)
  ) {stop(paste0("rho_grid must contain finite numeric values greater ",
        "than 1. The in-control value rho = 1 is not included ",
        "in the OC curve-comparison grid."))}

  rho_grid <- sort( unique(rho_grid))
  alpha <- 1 / target_ARL0

  # ==========================================================
  # General helper functions
  # ==========================================================

  collapse_set <- function(x) {
    x <- sort(unique(x))
    x <- x[!is.na(x)]
    if (length(x) == 0) {return("")}
    paste(x,collapse = ", ")
  }

  values_tied <- function(x,target,tolerance = comparison_tolerance) {
    if (length(x) == 0) {return(logical(0))}
    if (length(target) != 1 ||is.na(target)) {return( rep(FALSE,length(x))) }
    if (is.infinite(target)) {return( is.infinite(x) &sign(x) == sign(target))}
    is.finite(x) &abs(x - target) <=tolerance * max(1,  abs(target))}
  make_rho_label <- function(x) {
    x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
    if (anyNA(x) || any(!is.finite(x))) {stop("rho must contain only finite numeric values." )}
    x_formatted <- format(x,scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE,digits = 15)
    x_formatted <- sub(pattern = "0+$", replacement = "", x = x_formatted)
    x_formatted <- sub(pattern = "\\.$",replacement = "", x = x_formatted )
    gsub(pattern = "\\.", replacement = "p",x = x_formatted)
  }

  round_numeric_columns <- function(tbl) {
    numeric_columns <- names(tbl)[vapply( tbl,is.numeric, FUN.VALUE = logical(1))]
    tbl |>dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(numeric_columns), ~ round(.x, digits = round_digits)))
    }

  # ==========================================================
  # Extract and validate information returned by d_ccssbu_s()
  # ==========================================================

  extract_event_statistics <- function( fit,residue_type,d_value) {
    event_statistics <- fit$event_statistics
    if (
      is.null(event_statistics) ||
        !is.data.frame(event_statistics) ||
        nrow(event_statistics) == 0) {
      stop( paste0("No nonempty event_statistics table was returned by ",
          "d_ccssbu_s() for residue ",residue_type," and d = ", d_value,"." ))}

    required_columns <- c("Event","Event_index","S_t","n_locations_observed")
    missing_columns <- setdiff( required_columns, names(event_statistics))

    if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
      stop( paste0("The following required column(s) are missing from ",
          "event_statistics for residue ",residue_type," and d = ", d_value,": ",
          paste(missing_columns,collapse = ", "), ".")) }
    tibble::as_tibble(event_statistics)}

  extract_normalized_data <- function(fit,  residue_type, d_value) {
    normalized_data <- fit$normalized_data
    if (is.null(normalized_data) ||
        !is.data.frame(normalized_data) ||
        nrow(normalized_data) == 0) {
      stop(paste0("No nonempty normalized_data table was returned by ",
          "d_ccssbu_s() for residue ",residue_type," and d = ", d_value,"."))}
    required_columns <- c("Event_index","Normalized")
    missing_columns <- setdiff( required_columns, names(normalized_data))
    if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
      stop(paste0( "The following required column(s) are missing from ",
          "normalized_data for residue ", residue_type, " and d = ",d_value,": ",  paste( missing_columns,collapse = ", "),"."))}
    tibble::as_tibble(normalized_data)
    } # end of extract_normalized_data

  extract_q <- function(fit,residue_type) {
    q_value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(fit$q) )

    if (length(q_value) != 1 || is.na(q_value) ||!is.finite(q_value) ||q_value < 1) {
      stop(paste0("A valid q value was not returned by d_ccssbu_s() ","for residue ", residue_type, "." ))}

    q_integer <- as.integer(round(q_value))

    if (abs(q_value - q_integer) >  comparison_tolerance) {
      stop(paste0("The q value returned by d_ccssbu_s() is not an ",
          "integer for residue ", residue_type, "." ) )}
    q_integer
  } # end of extract_q

  extract_stage3a_z <- function(fit,residue_type) {
    normalized_data <- extract_normalized_data(fit = fit,residue_type = residue_type,d_value = 1)
    D_3A_event_index <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(fit$D_3A_event_index))
    D_3A_event_index <- sort(unique(D_3A_event_index[!is.na(D_3A_event_index)]))
    if (length(D_3A_event_index) == 0) {
      stop(paste0("No Stage 3A event indices were returned for residue ",residue_type,"."))}

    stage3a_z <- normalized_data |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$Event_index %in%D_3A_event_index) |>
      dplyr::pull(.data$Normalized)
    stage3a_z <- suppressWarnings(  as.numeric(stage3a_z) )
    stage3a_z <- stage3a_z[!is.na(stage3a_z) &is.finite(stage3a_z)]
    if (length(stage3a_z) < 2) {
      stop(paste0(   "At least two finite Stage 3A USL-normalized ",
          "observations are required for residue ", residue_type,"."))}
    stage3a_z
  } # end of extract_stage3a_z

  extract_bootstrap_scale <- function(fit,residue_type,  d_value) {

    bootstrap_scale <- fit$bootstrap_statistics_S
    if (is.null(bootstrap_scale)) {
      stop(paste0("bootstrap_statistics_S was not returned by ",
          "d_ccssbu_s() for residue ",residue_type, " and d = ",d_value,". Run d_ccssbu_s() with ",
          "keep_bootstrap_statistics = TRUE." ))}
    bootstrap_scale <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(bootstrap_scale) )
    bootstrap_scale <- bootstrap_scale[!is.na(bootstrap_scale) &is.finite(bootstrap_scale)]
    if (length(bootstrap_scale) == 0) {stop(paste0("No finite bootstrap scale statistics were found ",
          "for residue ", residue_type, " and d = ",d_value,"." ))}
    bootstrap_scale 
    } # end of extract_bootstrap_scale

  extract_chart_limit <- function(fit,limit_type, residue_type, d_value) {
    if (identical(limit_type, "CL")) {limit_value <- fit$CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot
    } else if (identical(limit_type, "UCL")) {
      limit_value <- fit$UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot
    } else {stop("limit_type must be either CL or UCL.")}
    limit_value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(limit_value))
    if (length(limit_value) != 1 ||is.na(limit_value) ||!is.finite(limit_value)) {
      stop(paste0("A finite ",limit_type," was not returned for residue ", residue_type," and d = ", d_value,"."))}
    limit_value
  } # end of extract_chart_limit

  extract_calibration_case <- function( fit,residue_type,d_value) {
    calibration_case <- as.character( fit$case_label)
    calibration_case <- calibration_case[!is.na(calibration_case) &nzchar(trimws(calibration_case))]
    if (length(calibration_case) == 0) {stop(paste0( "case_label was not returned for residue ", residue_type, " and d = ",d_value,"."))}
    calibration_case[[1]]
  } # end of extract_calibration_case 

  extract_n_cal <- function(fit,residue_type, d_value) {
    n_cal <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(fit$n_Cal))
    if (length(n_cal) != 1 || is.na(n_cal) ||!is.finite(n_cal) || n_cal < 1) {
      stop( paste0("A valid n_Cal value was not returned for residue ",
          residue_type, " and d = ",  d_value,".")) }
    n_cal_integer <- as.integer(round(n_cal))
    if (abs(n_cal - n_cal_integer) >comparison_tolerance) {
      stop(paste0("n_Cal is not an integer for residue ", residue_type, " and d = ",d_value,"."))}
    n_cal_integer
  } # end of extract_n_cal

  validate_ooc_count <- function( value,value_name, residue_type, d_value) {
    value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(value))
    if (length(value) != 1 || is.na(value) || !is.finite(value) ||  value < 0) {
      stop(paste0( "A valid ", value_name, " was not returned for residue ", residue_type,
          " and d = ",d_value,"." ))}
    value_integer <- as.integer(round(value))
    if (abs(value - value_integer) >comparison_tolerance) {
      stop(paste0(value_name," is not an integer for residue ",residue_type," and d = ",d_value, "." ) ) }
    value_integer
  } # endof validate_ooc_count

  # ==========================================================
  # Identify all-ND events
  # ==========================================================

  extract_all_nd_event_index <- function(fit, event_statistics, normalized_data,residue_type, d_value) {

    if ("all_ND_event" %in% names(event_statistics)) {
      all_nd_event_index <- event_statistics |>
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$all_ND_event), .data$all_ND_event) |>
        dplyr::pull(.data$Event_index)
    } else if ("ND_flag" %in% names(normalized_data)) {
      all_nd_event_index <- normalized_data |>
        dplyr::group_by(.data$Event_index) |>
        dplyr::summarise(all_ND_event = all(.data$ND_flag,na.rm = FALSE),.groups = "drop" ) |>
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$all_ND_event),.data$all_ND_event ) |>
        dplyr::pull(.data$Event_index)
    } else {stop(paste0("Neither all_ND_event in event_statistics nor ",
          "ND_flag in normalized_data was returned for residue ",
          residue_type," and d = ",  d_value,
          ". An all-ND event cannot be identified reliably.") ) }

    sort( unique( suppressWarnings( as.integer(all_nd_event_index))))
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Conventional normal-reference one-sided S-chart ARL1
  # ==========================================================

  conventional_s_chart_arl1 <- function(n,rho,alpha) {
    if (length(n) != 1 || is.na(n) || !is.finite(n) ||n < 2 ) {return(NA_real_) }
    if (length(rho) != 1 || is.na(rho) || !is.finite(rho) ||  rho <= 0) { return( NA_real_) }
    if (length(alpha) != 1 || is.na(alpha) || !is.finite(alpha) ||alpha <= 0 ||  alpha >= 1 ) { return( NA_real_) }
    n <- as.integer(round(n))
    degrees_of_freedom <- n - 1L
    chi_square_limit <- stats::qchisq(  p = 1 - alpha,  df = degrees_of_freedom  )
    chi_square_threshold <-    chi_square_limit / rho^2
    p1_s <- stats::pchisq(q = chi_square_threshold, df = degrees_of_freedom,lower.tail = FALSE)
    if (is.na(p1_s)) {return( NA_real_) }
    if (p1_s <= 0) {  return( Inf ) }
    1 / p1_s
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Determine conventional S-chart benchmark subgroup size
  # ==========================================================

  get_benchmark_n <- function(residue_type, residue_position,  event_statistics) {
    if (is.null(benchmark_n)) {
      if (!"n_locations_observed" %in%  names(event_statistics)) {
        stop( paste0("The column n_locations_observed was not found ",
            "for residue ",  residue_type,
            ". Provide benchmark_n explicitly." ) ) }

      observed_n <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(event_statistics$n_locations_observed))
      observed_n <- observed_n[!is.na(observed_n) & is.finite(observed_n) & observed_n >= 2]

      if (length(observed_n) == 0) {stop(paste0("No finite subgroup sizes of at least 2 were found ",
            "for residue ",  residue_type,". Provide benchmark_n explicitly." ))}
      benchmark_n_i <- as.integer(round(stats::median(observed_n) ))
    } else if (!is.null(names(benchmark_n)) &&residue_type %in% names(benchmark_n)) {
      benchmark_n_i <- suppressWarnings(as.integer( benchmark_n[[residue_type]] ) )
    } else if (length(benchmark_n) == 1) {
      benchmark_n_i <- suppressWarnings(as.integer( benchmark_n[[1]]) )
    } else if ( length(benchmark_n) ==  length(residue_types) ) {
      benchmark_n_i <- suppressWarnings(as.integer( benchmark_n[[residue_position]] )  )
    } else {stop( paste0(
          "benchmark_n must be NULL, one number, a named ",
          "vector by residue type, or a vector having the ",
          "same length as residue_types." ) ) }

    if (length(benchmark_n_i) != 1 || is.na(benchmark_n_i) || !is.finite(benchmark_n_i) ||benchmark_n_i < 2) 
      {stop(  paste0("The conventional S-chart benchmark requires ",
          "benchmark_n >= 2 for residue ",residue_type, "." ) )  }
    benchmark_n_i
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Recommend d for one residue type
  # ==========================================================

  recommend_d_for_residue <- function(candidate_tbl) {

    required_columns <- c(
      "Residue",
      "d",
      "q",
      "OOC_ND",
      "OOC_3A",
      "OOC_3B",
      "rho",
      "ARL1",
      "S_chart_ARL1"
    )

    missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns,names(candidate_tbl))

    if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {stop( paste0(
          "The recommendation input is missing column(s): ",
          paste(missing_columns,collapse = ", " )))}

    if (nrow(candidate_tbl) == 0) { stop("No candidate rows were supplied." )   }

    residue_values <- unique( as.character( candidate_tbl$Residue ))

    residue_values <- residue_values[!is.na(residue_values) &nzchar(trimws(residue_values))]

    if (length(residue_values) != 1) {
      stop( paste0("recommend_d_for_residue() requires exactly one ","residue type."))}
    residue_i <- residue_values[[1]]
    q_values <- unique( suppressWarnings( as.numeric(candidate_tbl$q)))

    q_values <- q_values[!is.na(q_values) & is.finite(q_values)]

    if (length(q_values) != 1) {stop( paste0("Exactly one finite q value is required for residue ",residue_i,".") )  }

    q_i <- as.integer(round(q_values[[1]]))

    candidate_values <- sort( unique(suppressWarnings(as.integer(candidate_tbl$d)  )) )

    candidate_values <- candidate_values[!is.na(candidate_values)]

    expected_candidates <- seq_len( q_i)

    if (!identical( candidate_values, expected_candidates )) {
      stop(paste0( "The candidate set for residue ",
          residue_i," must be d = 1, 2, ..., q."  ) ) }

    duplicate_grid_rows <- candidate_tbl |>
      dplyr::count(.data$d, .data$rho,name = "n_rows" ) |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$n_rows != 1 )

    if (nrow(duplicate_grid_rows) > 0) {stop( paste0(
          "At least one residue-d-rho combination has ",
          "duplicate rows for residue ",residue_i,"." ) ) }

    for (d_i in candidate_values) {
      observed_rho_i <- candidate_tbl |>dplyr::filter(.data$d == d_i) |>dplyr::pull(.data$rho)
      observed_rho_i <- sort( unique(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(observed_rho_i))))
      if (length(observed_rho_i) !=length(rho_grid) ||any(abs(observed_rho_i -rho_grid) >comparison_tolerance)) {
        stop(paste0("Candidate d = ",  d_i,
            " for residue ",  residue_i,
            " does not contain the complete rho grid."))}
    }

    candidate_identifier_check <- candidate_tbl |>
      dplyr::group_by(.data$d) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        n_OOC_ND = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$OOC_ND,na.rm = FALSE),
        n_OOC_3A = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$OOC_3A,na.rm = FALSE ),
        n_OOC_3B = dplyr::n_distinct( .data$OOC_3B,  na.rm = FALSE),
        .groups = "drop") |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$n_OOC_ND > 1 |.data$n_OOC_3A > 1 |.data$n_OOC_3B > 1)

    if (nrow(candidate_identifier_check) > 0) {stop( paste0("OOC counts vary across rho for at least one d ",
          "for residue ", residue_i,"." ))}

    candidate_metrics <- candidate_tbl |>
      dplyr::mutate(R = .data$ARL1 /.data$S_chart_ARL1) |>
      dplyr::group_by(.data$Residue,.data$d,.data$q ) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        OOC_ND =          dplyr::first(.data$OOC_ND),
        OOC_3A =          dplyr::first(.data$OOC_3A),
        OOC_3B =          dplyr::first(.data$OOC_3B),
        all_R_valid = all(!is.na(.data$R) &.data$R > 0),
        W = if (all(!is.na(.data$R) &.data$R > 0)) {max(.data$R)} else {NA_real_},
        G = if (all(!is.na(.data$R) & .data$R > 0 )) {exp(mean( log(.data$R)))} else {NA_real_},
        .groups = "drop") |>
      dplyr::arrange(.data$d)

    if (any(!candidate_metrics$all_R_valid) ||anyNA(candidate_metrics$W) || anyNA(candidate_metrics$G)) {
      stop(paste0( "At least one relative ARL curve is invalid for ",
          "residue ",  residue_i,"."))}

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Steps 5 and 6. Construct D1, D2, and A
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    C_d <- sort(unique( candidate_metrics$d))
    D1 <- candidate_metrics |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$OOC_ND == 0) |>
      dplyr::pull(.data$d) |>
      unique() |>
      sort()
    D2 <- candidate_metrics |>dplyr::filter(.data$OOC_3A == 0 ) |>
      dplyr::pull(.data$d) |>
      unique() |>
      sort()
    D12 <- sort(intersect(D1, D2) )

    if (length(D12) > 0) {
      observed_behavior_case <- "D1_intersect_D2"
      A <- D12
    } else if (length(D1) > 0) {
      observed_behavior_case <-  "D1"
      A <- D1
    } else if (length(D2) > 0) {
      observed_behavior_case <-  "D2"
      A <- D2
    } else {
      observed_behavior_case <-"C_d"
      A <- C_d
    }

    A <- sort(unique(A))
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 7. Construct U
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    metrics_A <- candidate_metrics |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$d %in% A) |>
      dplyr::arrange( .data$d )

    U <- metrics_A |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$W <=1 + comparison_tolerance) |>
      dplyr::pull(.data$d ) |>  unique() |>  sort()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 8. Apply U or XO selection
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    tied_W_d <- integer(0)
    tied_G_d <- integer(0)
    minimum_W <- NA_real_
    minimum_G <- NA_real_
    if (length(U) > 0) {
      arl_curve_case <- "U"
      d_rec <- as.integer(max(U))
      tied_W_d <- d_rec
      tied_G_d <- d_rec
      selection_rule <- paste0("U case: maximum d in U according to Rule 3")
    } else {
      arl_curve_case <- "XO"
      minimum_W <- min( metrics_A$W)
      tied_W_d <- metrics_A |>
        dplyr::filter(values_tied(.data$W,minimum_W)) |>
        dplyr::pull(.data$d) |> unique() |> sort()
      if (length(tied_W_d) == 0) {stop(paste0("No candidate attained the minimum W value for ","residue ", residue_i,"."))}
      metrics_W_tie <- metrics_A |> dplyr::filter(.data$d %in% tied_W_d)
      minimum_G <- min( metrics_W_tie$G)
      tied_G_d <- metrics_W_tie |>
        dplyr::filter(values_tied(.data$G,minimum_G)) |>
        dplyr::pull(.data$d) |> unique() |> sort()

      if (length(tied_G_d) == 0) {stop( paste0("No candidate attained the minimum G value among ",
            "the candidates tied on W for residue ",residue_i,".")) }
      d_rec <- as.integer(max(tied_G_d))
      selection_rule <- paste0(
        "XO case: minimum W over A; minimum G among ",
        "candidates tied on W; maximum d if a tie remains ",
        "according to Rule 3")
    }

    selected_metrics <- metrics_A |>dplyr::filter(.data$d == d_rec)
    selected_W <- selected_metrics$W[[1]]
    selected_G <- selected_metrics$G[[1]]

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Assign one of the eight decision cases
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    case_key <- paste(observed_behavior_case,arl_curve_case,sep = "|" )
    case_lookup <- c(
      "D1_intersect_D2|U" = "Case 1",
      "D1_intersect_D2|XO" = "Case 2",
      "D1|U" = "Case 3",
      "D1|XO" = "Case 4",
      "D2|U" = "Case 5",
      "D2|XO" = "Case 6",
      "C_d|U" = "Case 7",
      "C_d|XO" = "Case 8"
    )

    selected_case <- unname(case_lookup[case_key])

    if (length(selected_case) != 1 || is.na(selected_case)) {
      stop( paste0("The eight-case decision path could not be assigned ",
          "for residue ", residue_i,"." ))}
    notes <- character(0)
    if (length(D1) == 0) {notes <- c( notes,paste0("D1 is empty: every candidate d flagged at least ",
          "one all-ND event as OOC."))
    }

    if (length(D2) == 0) {notes <- c( notes,paste0( "D2 is empty: every candidate d flagged at least ",
          "one nominal Stage 3A event as OOC.") )
    }

    if (length(U) == 0) {
      notes <- c(notes, paste0("U is empty: every candidate in A has at least one ",
          "rho value for which its d-CCSSBU-S ARL1 exceeds ",
          "the corresponding S-chart ARL1 benchmark." ) )
    }

    if (arl_curve_case == "XO" && length(tied_W_d) > 1) {
      notes <- c( notes,paste0("Candidate d values ", collapse_set(tied_W_d), " attained the same minimum W value." ))}

    if (arl_curve_case == "XO" &&length(tied_G_d) > 1){ 
      notes <- c( notes,paste0("Candidate d values ", collapse_set(tied_G_d),
          " remained tied after comparing G. The largest ",
          "tied value of d was selected according to Rule 3." ))}

    if (arl_curve_case == "U") {notes <- c(notes, paste0(
          "The largest d in U was selected according to Rule 3 ",
          "because every candidate in U has an ARL1 curve that ",
          "remains below or touches the S-chart benchmark ",
          "throughout the complete rho grid." ) ) }

    recommendation_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
      Residue = residue_i,
      recommended_d = d_rec,
      q = q_i,
      observed_behavior_case =  observed_behavior_case,
      arl_curve_case =  arl_curve_case,
      selected_case =    selected_case,
      selection_rule =  selection_rule,
      C_d_values =collapse_set(C_d),
      D1_values =   collapse_set(D1),
      D2_values =   collapse_set(D2),
      A_values =  collapse_set(A),
      U_values =  collapse_set(U),
      W_tied_d_values =  collapse_set(tied_W_d),
      G_tied_d_values =  collapse_set(tied_G_d),
      minimum_W =   minimum_W,
      minimum_G_among_W_ties =  minimum_G,
      recommended_W =    selected_W,
      recommended_G =  selected_G,
      selection_path = paste( selected_case,observed_behavior_case, arl_curve_case, selection_rule, sep = " | " ),
      recommendation_notes = paste( notes,collapse = " | ")
    )

    candidate_metrics_output <- candidate_metrics |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        in_C_d =.data$d %in% C_d,
        in_D1 =  .data$d %in% D1,
        in_D2 =  .data$d %in% D2,
        in_A =  .data$d %in% A,
        in_U =.data$d %in% U,
        selected =.data$d == d_rec)

    list(recommendation =recommendation_tbl,candidate_metrics = candidate_metrics_output)
  }
  # ==========================================================
  # Fit all residue types and candidate d values
  # ==========================================================
  all_rows <- list()
  all_fit_objects <- list()
  all_candidate_information <- list()
  all_benchmark_models <- list()

  row_id <- 1L
  fit_id <- 1L
  for (rr in seq_along(residue_types)) {
    residue_type_i <- residue_types[[rr]]
    sheet_i <- sheets[[rr]]
    if (isTRUE(verbose)) {message("Processing residue type: ",residue_type_i," | sheet: ",sheet_i)}

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 1. Initial d = 1 fit to determine q
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    fit_q <- d_ccssbu_s(
      file = file,
      equipment_label = equipment_label,
      residue_type = residue_type_i,
      sheet = sheet_i,
      d = 1,
      n_stage3A_events = n_stage3A_events,
      target_ARL0 = target_ARL0,
      B = B,
      c_smooth = c_smooth,
      h_min = h_min,
      seed = seed + 1000L * rr + 1L,
      scale_eligibility_threshold =
        scale_eligibility_threshold,
      scale_distinct_digits =
        scale_distinct_digits,
      cluster_col = cluster_col,
      cluster_group_cols =
        cluster_group_cols,
      cluster_round_digits =
        cluster_round_digits,
      event_col = event_col,
      location_col = location_col,
      result_col = result_col,
      lod_col = lod_col,
      loq_col = loq_col,
      usl_col = usl_col,
      plot_chart = FALSE,
      save_outputs = FALSE,
      return_bootstrap_matrix = FALSE,
      keep_bootstrap_statistics = TRUE)

    event_statistics_q <- extract_event_statistics( fit = fit_q,residue_type = residue_type_i,d_value = 1)
    q_residue <- extract_q( fit = fit_q,residue_type = residue_type_i )
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 2. Construct benchmark model once per residue
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    stage3a_z_i <- extract_stage3a_z( fit = fit_q,residue_type = residue_type_i)
    mu_0_i <- mean(stage3a_z_i)
    s_Z_i <- stats::sd(stage3a_z_i)
    if (is.na(mu_0_i) ||!is.finite(mu_0_i)) {
      stop( paste0("The Stage 3A mean could not be calculated for ",
          "residue ",residue_type_i,"."))}
    if (is.na(s_Z_i) || !is.finite(s_Z_i) ||s_Z_i < 0) {stop(paste0("The Stage 3A empirical standard deviation could ",
          "not be calculated for residue ",residue_type_i, "."))}
    sigma_Z_i <- max( s_Z_i,h_min)
    if (!is.finite(sigma_Z_i) ||sigma_Z_i <= 0) {stop(paste0("sigma_Z must be positive for residue ",residue_type_i,  "."  ) ) }
    benchmark_n_i <- get_benchmark_n(
      residue_type = residue_type_i,
      residue_position = rr,
      event_statistics =event_statistics_q)
    degrees_of_freedom_i <-     benchmark_n_i - 1L
    chi_square_limit_i <- stats::qchisq(p = 1 - alpha,df = degrees_of_freedom_i  )
    UCL_S_i <- sigma_Z_i * sqrt(chi_square_limit_i /degrees_of_freedom_i)
    sigma_1_i <- rho_grid * sigma_Z_i

    benchmark_curve_i <- tibble::tibble(
      rho = rho_grid,
      mu_0 = mu_0_i,
      s_Z = s_Z_i,
      sigma_Z = sigma_Z_i,
      sigma_1 = sigma_1_i,
      benchmark_n = benchmark_n_i,
      degrees_of_freedom =    degrees_of_freedom_i,
      chi_square_limit =    chi_square_limit_i,
      UCL_S = UCL_S_i,
      S_chart_ARL1 = vapply(
        rho_grid,
        conventional_s_chart_arl1,
        n = benchmark_n_i,
        alpha = alpha,
        FUN.VALUE = numeric(1))
    )

    if (anyNA(benchmark_curve_i$S_chart_ARL1)) {stop(paste0("At least one conventional S-chart ARL1 benchmark ",
          "could not be calculated for residue ",
          residue_type_i, "."))}

    all_benchmark_models[[residue_type_i]] <- list(
      Residue = residue_type_i,
      stage3a_z = stage3a_z_i,
      mu_0 = mu_0_i,
      s_Z = s_Z_i,
      sigma_Z = sigma_Z_i,
      h_min = h_min,
      benchmark_n = benchmark_n_i,
      degrees_of_freedom =    degrees_of_freedom_i,
      chi_square_limit =      chi_square_limit_i,
      UCL_S = UCL_S_i,
      rho_grid = rho_grid,
      sigma_1 = sigma_1_i,
      benchmark_table =   benchmark_curve_i
    )

    if (isTRUE(verbose)) {message("  q = ", q_residue,
        " | benchmark n = ",benchmark_n_i,
        " | mu_0 = ", signif(mu_0_i, 6),
        " | s_Z = ",signif(s_Z_i, 6),
        " | sigma_Z = ",  signif(sigma_Z_i, 6),
        " | UCL_S = ",  signif(UCL_S_i, 6)) }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Steps 1 and 3. Fit d = 1, 2, ..., q
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    for (d_i in seq_len(q_residue)) {
      if (isTRUE(verbose)) {message("  Fitting d = ", d_i," of ",  q_residue) }
      if (d_i == 1L) {fit_i <- fit_q} 
      else {fit_i <- d_ccssbu_s(
          file = file,
          equipment_label = equipment_label,
          residue_type = residue_type_i,
          sheet = sheet_i,
          d = d_i,
          n_stage3A_events =      n_stage3A_events,
          target_ARL0 =         target_ARL0,
          B = B,
          c_smooth =        c_smooth,
          h_min =         h_min,
          seed =    seed + 1000L * rr + d_i,
          scale_eligibility_threshold =    scale_eligibility_threshold,
          scale_distinct_digits =     scale_distinct_digits,
          cluster_col =    cluster_col,
          cluster_group_cols =  cluster_group_cols,
          cluster_round_digits =  cluster_round_digits,
          event_col =      event_col,
          location_col =  location_col,
          result_col =    result_col,
          lod_col =       lod_col,
          loq_col =        loq_col,
          usl_col =         usl_col,
          plot_chart = FALSE,
          save_outputs = FALSE,
          return_bootstrap_matrix = FALSE,
          keep_bootstrap_statistics = TRUE )}

      event_statistics_i <- extract_event_statistics(fit = fit_i,residue_type = residue_type_i, d_value = d_i )
      normalized_data_i <- extract_normalized_data(  fit = fit_i, residue_type = residue_type_i,d_value = d_i )
      CL_i <- extract_chart_limit(  fit = fit_i,  limit_type = "CL",  residue_type = residue_type_i,  d_value = d_i )
      UCL_i <- extract_chart_limit( fit = fit_i,limit_type = "UCL", residue_type = residue_type_i,  d_value = d_i  )
      calibration_case_i <- extract_calibration_case( fit = fit_i,  residue_type = residue_type_i,  d_value = d_i )
      n_cal_i <- extract_n_cal(fit = fit_i,residue_type = residue_type_i,d_value = d_i)
      bootstrap_scale_i <-extract_bootstrap_scale(fit = fit_i,residue_type = residue_type_i,d_value = d_i)

      n_bootstrap_i <- length(bootstrap_scale_i )

      if (n_bootstrap_i < 1) {stop(paste0("No bootstrap scale statistics were available for ",
            "residue ", residue_type_i, " and d = ",d_i,"."))}

      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Observed OOC counts for Rules 1 and 2
      # ------------------------------------------------------
      all_nd_event_index_i <-    extract_all_nd_event_index(
          fit = fit_i,
          event_statistics =  event_statistics_i,
          normalized_data =  normalized_data_i,
          residue_type =  residue_type_i,
          d_value =   d_i )

      signal_i <- event_statistics_i$S_t >UCL_i
      signal_i[is.na(signal_i)] <- FALSE
      OOC_ND_tbl_i <- event_statistics_i |>
        dplyr::mutate(Signal_d_selection_S =signal_i) |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$Event_index %in%all_nd_event_index_i, .data$Signal_d_selection_S)

      OOC_3A_tbl_i <- event_statistics_i |>
        dplyr::mutate(Signal_d_selection_S =signal_i) |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$Event_index %in%  fit_i$D_3A_event_index, .data$Signal_d_selection_S)

      OOC_3B_tbl_i <- event_statistics_i |>
        dplyr::mutate(Signal_d_selection_S =signal_i) |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$Event_index %in%fit_i$monitoring_event_index,.data$Signal_d_selection_S)

      OOC_ND_i <- nrow(  OOC_ND_tbl_i )

      OOC_3A_i <- validate_ooc_count(
        value = fit_i$n_stage3A_ooc,
        value_name = "n_stage3A_ooc",
        residue_type = residue_type_i,
        d_value = d_i)

      OOC_3B_i <- validate_ooc_count(
        value = fit_i$n_stage3B_ooc,
        value_name = "n_stage3B_ooc",
        residue_type = residue_type_i,
        d_value = d_i)

      if (OOC_3A_i != nrow(OOC_3A_tbl_i)) {stop( paste0( "The recalculated Stage 3A OOC count does not ",
            "equal fit$n_stage3A_ooc for residue ",  residue_type_i," and d = ",  d_i,".")) }

      if (OOC_3B_i != nrow(OOC_3B_tbl_i)) {stop(paste0("The recalculated Stage 3B OOC count does not ","equal fit$n_stage3B_ooc for residue ",
                                                       residue_type_i, " and d = ",d_i,  "."))}

      OOC_ND_events_i <- if ( OOC_ND_i > 0) { paste(OOC_ND_tbl_i$Event, collapse = ", " ) } else {""}
      OOC_3A_events_i <- if ( OOC_3A_i > 0) { paste(OOC_3A_tbl_i$Event, collapse = ", ")} else {""}
      OOC_3B_events_i <- if (OOC_3B_i > 0) {paste(OOC_3B_tbl_i$Event, collapse = ", ")} else {""}

      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Step 3. Candidate-specific ARL1 curves
      # S_b^{*,rho}(d) = rho S_b^*(d)
      # ------------------------------------------------------
      n_signals_i <- vapply(rho_grid,FUN = function(rho_value) {sum(rho_value *bootstrap_scale_i >UCL_i,na.rm = TRUE) }, FUN.VALUE = integer(1))
      p1_i <- n_signals_i / n_bootstrap_i
      ARL1_uncensored_i <- ifelse(p1_i > 0,  1 / p1_i,  Inf )
      expected_truncated_run_length_i <-ifelse( p1_i > 0, (1 -(1 - p1_i)^T_max) / p1_i,T_max )
      ARL1_exceeds_T_max_i <- !is.finite(ARL1_uncensored_i) | ARL1_uncensored_i > T_max
      candidate_shift_tbl_i <-  tibble::tibble(
          rho = rho_grid,
          n_bootstrap =   n_bootstrap_i,
          n_signals =   n_signals_i,
          p1 =  p1_i,
          ARL1 =  ARL1_uncensored_i,
          expected_truncated_run_length =  expected_truncated_run_length_i,
          ARL1_exceeds_T_max =  ARL1_exceeds_T_max_i
        )

      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Step 4. Add conventional S-chart benchmark
      # ------------------------------------------------------
      candidate_rows_i <- candidate_shift_tbl_i |>
        dplyr::left_join(benchmark_curve_i, by = "rho") |>
        dplyr::mutate(Equipment =  equipment_label,
          Residue = residue_type_i,
          sheet = as.character(sheet_i),
          d =   as.integer(d_i),
          q =  as.integer(q_residue),
          calibration_case =  calibration_case_i,
          nCal =  as.integer(n_cal_i),
          OOC_ND = as.integer(OOC_ND_i),
          OOC_3A =  as.integer(OOC_3A_i),
          OOC_3B =  as.integer(OOC_3B_i),
          OOC_ND_events =  OOC_ND_events_i,
          OOC_3A_events = OOC_3A_events_i,
          OOC_3B_events = OOC_3B_events_i,
          CL =  CL_i,
          UCL = UCL_i,
          target_ARL0 = target_ARL0,
          alpha = alpha,
          B = B,
          T_max = T_max,.before = 1 ) |>
        dplyr::mutate(relative_ARL_ratio =  .data$ARL1 /.data$S_chart_ARL1)
      
      all_rows[[row_id]] <-  candidate_rows_i
      fit_object_name <- paste0(residue_type_i, "_d",  d_i)

      all_fit_objects[[fit_id]] <-fit_i
      names(all_fit_objects)[[fit_id]] <-  fit_object_name
      all_candidate_information[[fit_id]] <-list(
          Residue =  residue_type_i,
          d =  as.integer(d_i),
          q =  as.integer(q_residue),
          calibration_case =  calibration_case_i,
          nCal =  as.integer(n_cal_i),
          calibration_data = fit_i$calibration_data,
          calibration_status =fit_i$cluster_calibration_status,
          CL =  CL_i,
          UCL =   UCL_i,
          OOC_ND = as.integer(OOC_ND_i),
          OOC_3A = as.integer(OOC_3A_i),
          OOC_3B =  as.integer(OOC_3B_i),
          all_ND_event_index = all_nd_event_index_i,
          benchmark_n =  as.integer(benchmark_n_i),
          mu_0 = mu_0_i,
          s_Z =  s_Z_i,
          sigma_Z = sigma_Z_i,
          rho_grid = rho_grid,
          sigma_1 =  sigma_1_i,
          degrees_of_freedom =   degrees_of_freedom_i,
          chi_square_limit =  chi_square_limit_i,
          UCL_S =  UCL_S_i,
          bootstrap_scale_statistics =  bootstrap_scale_i,
          event_statistics =  event_statistics_i)
      names(all_candidate_information)[[fit_id]] <- fit_object_name
      row_id <- row_id + 1L
      fit_id <- fit_id + 1L
    }
  }

  if (length(all_rows) == 0) {stop("No candidate-specific ARL1 results were generated." )}

  # ==========================================================
  # Combine candidate-specific ARL1 results
  # ==========================================================
  arl1_long_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_rows) |>
    dplyr::arrange(match(.data$Residue,residue_types),.data$d,.data$rho)
  arl1_split <- split(arl1_long_tbl,factor( arl1_long_tbl$Residue,levels = residue_types),drop = TRUE )
  recommendation_outputs <- lapply(arl1_split,recommend_d_for_residue)
  recommendation_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply( recommendation_outputs, function(x) {x$recommendation})) |>
    dplyr::arrange( match(.data$Residue,residue_types))
  candidate_metrics_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply( recommendation_outputs,function(x) {x$candidate_metrics})) |>
    dplyr::arrange( match(.data$Residue,residue_types),.data$d)

  # ==========================================================
  # Add selection information to long-format ARL1 table
  # ==========================================================
  arl1_long_tbl <- arl1_long_tbl |>
    dplyr::left_join(candidate_metrics_tbl |>
        dplyr::select(
          .data$Residue,
          .data$d,
          .data$W,
          .data$G,
          .data$in_C_d,
          .data$in_D1,
          .data$in_D2,
          .data$in_A,
          .data$in_U,
          .data$selected), by = c("Residue","d")) |>
    dplyr::left_join(recommendation_tbl |>
        dplyr::select(
          .data$Residue,
          .data$recommended_d,
          .data$observed_behavior_case,
          .data$arl_curve_case,
          .data$selected_case,
          .data$selection_rule,
          .data$A_values,
          .data$U_values,
          .data$selection_path,
          .data$recommendation_notes),by = "Residue") |>
    dplyr::arrange(match(.data$Residue,residue_types),.data$d,.data$rho )

  # ==========================================================
  # Construct wide ARL1 table internally
  # ==========================================================

  arl1_wide_tbl <- arl1_long_tbl |>
    dplyr::mutate(rho_label = make_rho_label(.data$rho)) |>
    dplyr::select(
      .data$Residue,
      .data$d,
      .data$q,
      .data$calibration_case,
      .data$nCal,
      .data$OOC_ND,
      .data$OOC_3A,
      .data$OOC_3B,
      .data$benchmark_n,
      .data$mu_0,
      .data$s_Z,
      .data$sigma_Z,
      .data$degrees_of_freedom,
      .data$chi_square_limit,
      .data$UCL_S,
      .data$CL,
      .data$UCL,
      .data$W,
      .data$G,
      .data$in_C_d,
      .data$in_D1,
      .data$in_D2,
      .data$in_A,
      .data$in_U,
      .data$selected,
      .data$recommended_d,
      .data$observed_behavior_case,
      .data$arl_curve_case,
      .data$selected_case,
      .data$selection_rule,
      .data$A_values,
      .data$U_values,
      .data$selection_path,
      .data$recommendation_notes,
      .data$rho_label,
      .data$sigma_1,
      .data$S_chart_ARL1,
      .data$ARL1,
      .data$relative_ARL_ratio) |>
    dplyr::distinct() |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(
        "Residue",
        "d",
        "q",
        "calibration_case",
        "nCal",
        "OOC_ND",
        "OOC_3A",
        "OOC_3B",
        "benchmark_n",
        "mu_0",
        "s_Z",
        "sigma_Z",
        "degrees_of_freedom",
        "chi_square_limit",
        "UCL_S",
        "CL",
        "UCL",
        "W",
        "G",
        "in_C_d",
        "in_D1",
        "in_D2",
        "in_A",
        "in_U",
        "selected",
        "recommended_d",
        "observed_behavior_case",
        "arl_curve_case",
        "selected_case",
        "selection_rule",
        "A_values",
        "U_values",
        "selection_path",
        "recommendation_notes"),
      names_from = .data$rho_label,
      values_from = c(.data$sigma_1,.data$S_chart_ARL1, .data$ARL1, .data$relative_ARL_ratio),
      names_glue ="{.value}_rho_{rho_label}",
      names_sort =FALSE) |>
    dplyr::arrange( match(.data$Residue,  residue_types), .data$d )

  # ==========================================================
  # Extract recommended d values
  # ==========================================================
  recommended_d_named <- stats::setNames(as.integer( recommendation_tbl$recommended_d), recommendation_tbl$Residue)
  DAR_d <- if ( "DAR" %in% names(recommended_d_named)){as.integer( recommended_d_named[["DAR"]])} else { NA_integer_}
  CAR_d <- if ("CAR" %in% names(recommended_d_named)){as.integer(recommended_d_named[["CAR"]])} else {NA_integer_}
  Mic_d <- if ("Mic" %in% names(recommended_d_named)){as.integer(recommended_d_named[["Mic"]])} else {NA_integer_}

  # ==========================================================
  # Construct rounded display versions
  # ==========================================================
  arl1_long_display_tbl <- round_numeric_columns(  arl1_long_tbl  )
  arl1_wide_display_tbl <- round_numeric_columns(  arl1_wide_tbl  )
  recommendation_display_tbl <- round_numeric_columns(    recommendation_tbl  )
  candidate_metrics_display_tbl <- round_numeric_columns(    candidate_metrics_tbl  )

  # ==========================================================
  # Completion messages
  # ==========================================================
  if (isTRUE(verbose)) {
    message("Completed d-CCSSBU-S d selection.")
    for ( ii in seq_len(nrow(recommendation_tbl))) {
      message("  ", recommendation_tbl$Residue[[ii]],": recommended d = ",
        recommendation_tbl$recommended_d[[ii]]," | ", recommendation_tbl$selected_case[[ii]],
        " | ",recommendation_tbl$arl_curve_case[[ii]])}
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Return all results
  # ==========================================================

  result <- list(# Recommended d values
    recommendations = recommendation_tbl,
    recommendations_display = recommendation_display_tbl,
    recommended_d = recommended_d_named,
    DAR_d =  DAR_d,
    CAR_d =  CAR_d,
    Mic_d =  Mic_d,
    # Candidate-level selection metrics
    candidate_metrics = candidate_metrics_tbl,
    candidate_metrics_display = candidate_metrics_display_tbl,
    # ARL1 results
    arl1_raw =  arl1_long_tbl,
    arl1_long =  arl1_long_tbl,
    arl1_long_display = arl1_long_display_tbl,
    arl1_wide =  arl1_wide_tbl,
    arl1_wide_display =  arl1_wide_display_tbl,
    # Benchmark models
    benchmark_models =  all_benchmark_models,
    # Full fitted chart objects
    fit_objects = all_fit_objects,
    # Detailed candidate information
    candidate_information = all_candidate_information,
    # Settings
    benchmark_settings = list(target_ARL0 =target_ARL0,
      alpha =  alpha,
      rho_grid =  rho_grid,
      benchmark_n =   benchmark_n,
      h_min = h_min,
      T_max = T_max),
    settings = list(equipment_label = equipment_label,
      residue_types = residue_types,
      sheets =  sheets,
      n_stage3A_events =n_stage3A_events,
      target_ARL0 = target_ARL0,
      alpha = alpha,
      B = B,
      c_smooth =  c_smooth,
      h_min =  h_min,
      seed =  seed,
      scale_eligibility_threshold = scale_eligibility_threshold,
      scale_distinct_digits = scale_distinct_digits,
      cluster_col =   cluster_col,
      cluster_group_cols = cluster_group_cols,
      cluster_round_digits = cluster_round_digits,
      rho_grid =  rho_grid,
      T_max =  T_max,
      benchmark_n =  benchmark_n,
      comparison_tolerance =  comparison_tolerance,
      round_digits =  round_digits),
    call =match.call())
  class(result) <- c("d_ccssbu_s_d_selection_arl1", "list")
  return(result)
}
```

```{r render_function_s_type}
render_d_ccssbu_s_arl1_tbl <- function(
  tbl,
  caption = "d-CCSSBU-S ARL1 simulation results.",
  label = NULL,
  font_size = 7
) {

  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {

    tbl %>%
      knitr::kable(
        format = "latex",
        booktabs = TRUE,
        digits = 4,
        caption = caption,
        label = label
      ) %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        latex_options = c(
          "scale_down",
          "hold_position"
        ),
        position = "center",
        font_size = font_size
      )

  } else {

    tbl %>%
      knitr::kable(
        digits = 4,
        caption = caption
      ) %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        bootstrap_options = c(
          "striped",
          "condensed",
          "hover"
        ),
        full_width = FALSE
      )
  }
}

render_d_ccssbu_s_recommendation_tbl <- function(
  tbl,
  caption = "Recommended d values for the d-CCSSBU-S chart.",
  label = NULL,
  font_size = 7,
  show_notes = FALSE
) {

  if (is.null(tbl)) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "tbl is NULL. Available outputs are typically ",
        "result$recommendations or ",
        "result$recommendations_display."
      )
    )
  }

  if (!is.data.frame(tbl)) {
    stop(
      "tbl must be a data frame."
    )
  }

  if (nrow(tbl) == 0) {
    stop(
      "tbl contains no rows."
    )
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Auto-map old and new output names
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  if (!"recommended_W" %in% names(tbl)) {

    if ("W" %in% names(tbl)) {
      tbl$recommended_W <- tbl$W
    }
  }

  if (!"recommended_G" %in% names(tbl)) {

    if ("G" %in% names(tbl)) {
      tbl$recommended_G <- tbl$G
    }
  }

  required_columns <- c(
    "Residue",
    "recommended_d",
    "q",
    "observed_behavior_case",
    "arl_curve_case",
    "selected_case",
    "selection_rule",
    "A_values",
    "U_values",
    "recommended_W",
    "recommended_G"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(tbl)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {

    stop(
      paste0(
        "Missing column(s): ",
        paste(
          missing_columns,
          collapse = ", "
        ),
        "\n\nAvailable columns:\n",
        paste(
          names(tbl),
          collapse = ", "
        )
      )
    )
  }

  if (!"recommendation_notes" %in% names(tbl)) {
    tbl$recommendation_notes <- ""
  }

  escape_latex_text <- function(x) {

    x <- as.character(x)

    x[is.na(x)] <- ""

    placeholder <- "BACKSLASHPLACEHOLDER"

    x <- gsub("\\\\", placeholder, x)

    x <- gsub(
      "([#$%&_{}])",
      "\\\\\\1",
      x,
      perl = TRUE
    )

    x <- gsub(
      "~",
      "\\\\textasciitilde{}",
      x,
      fixed = TRUE
    )

    x <- gsub("\\^","\\\\textasciicircum{}",  x,  perl = TRUE  )

    x <- gsub(
      placeholder,
      "\\\\textbackslash{}",
      x,
      fixed = TRUE
    )

    x
  }

  observed_case_label <- dplyr::case_when(
    tbl$observed_behavior_case == "D1_intersect_D2" ~ "D1 ∩ D2",
    tbl$observed_behavior_case == "D1" ~ "D1",
    tbl$observed_behavior_case == "D2" ~ "D2",
    tbl$observed_behavior_case == "C_d" ~ "{1,...,q}",
    TRUE ~ tbl$observed_behavior_case
  )

  tbl_display <- tbl %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Residue,
      d = recommended_d,
      q,
      Case = selected_case,
      `Admissible Set` = observed_case_label,
      `ARL Case` = arl_curve_case,
      A = A_values,
      U = U_values,
      W = recommended_W,
      G = recommended_G,
      Rule = selection_rule
    )

  notes_tbl <- tbl %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Residue = as.character(Residue),
      Note = as.character(recommendation_notes)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(Note),
      nzchar(trimws(Note))
    )

  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {

    table_output <- tbl_display %>%
      knitr::kable(
        format = "latex",
        booktabs = TRUE,
        digits = 4,
        caption = caption,
        label = label,
        escape = TRUE
      ) %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        latex_options = c(
          "scale_down",
          "hold_position"
        ),
        position = "center",
        font_size = font_size
      )

    cat(as.character(table_output), "\n")

    if (
      isTRUE(show_notes) &&
      nrow(notes_tbl) > 0
    ) {

      cat("\\vspace{1mm}\n")
      cat("\\begin{minipage}{0.96\\textwidth}\n")
      cat("\\footnotesize\n")
      cat("\\noindent\\textit{Notes.}\n")
      cat("\\begin{description}\n")

      for (i in seq_len(nrow(notes_tbl))) {

        cat(
          paste0(
            "\\item[\\textit{",
            escape_latex_text(notes_tbl$Residue[i]),
            ":}] ",
            escape_latex_text(notes_tbl$Note[i]),
            "\n"
          )
        )
      }

      cat("\\end{description}\n")
      cat("\\end{minipage}\n")
    }

  } else {

    table_output <- tbl_display %>%
      knitr::kable(
        digits = 4,
        caption = caption,
        escape = TRUE
      ) %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        bootstrap_options = c(
          "striped",
          "condensed",
          "hover",
          "responsive"
        ),
        full_width = FALSE
      )

    cat(as.character(table_output), "\n")
  }

  invisible(tbl_display)
}
```

```{r plot-d-ccssbu-s-arl1-curves-function}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

plot_d_ccssbu_s_arl1_curves <- function(
  tbl,
  equipment_label = "Equipment",
  output_file = NULL,
  residue_order = c("DAR", "CAR", "Mic"),
  width = 9,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 300,
  y_log10 = TRUE,
  show_points = TRUE,
  base_size = 11
) {

  required_packages <- c(
    "dplyr",
    "ggplot2",
    "patchwork"
  )

  missing_packages <- required_packages[
    !vapply(
      required_packages,
      requireNamespace,
      quietly = TRUE,
      FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
    )
  ]

  if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Please install the following package(s): ",
      paste(
        missing_packages,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  if (!is.data.frame(tbl)) {
    stop("tbl must be a data frame.")
  }

  if (nrow(tbl) == 0) {
    stop("tbl contains no rows.")
  }

  required_columns <- c(
    "Residue",
    "d",
    "rho",
    "ARL1",
    "S_chart_ARL1"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(tbl)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "The following required column(s) are missing from tbl: ",
      paste(
        missing_columns,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  if (
    length(equipment_label) != 1 ||
    is.na(equipment_label) ||
    !nzchar(trimws(equipment_label))
  ) {
    stop(
      "equipment_label must be one nonempty character value."
    )
  }

  if (
    length(width) != 1 ||
    is.na(width) ||
    !is.finite(width) ||
    width <= 0
  ) {
    stop("width must be a positive finite number.")
  }

  if (
    length(height) != 1 ||
    is.na(height) ||
    !is.finite(height) ||
    height <= 0
  ) {
    stop("height must be a positive finite number.")
  }

  if (
    length(dpi) != 1 ||
    is.na(dpi) ||
    !is.finite(dpi) ||
    dpi <= 0
  ) {
    stop("dpi must be a positive finite number.")
  }

  residue_order <- unique(
    as.character(residue_order)
  )

  available_residues <- unique(
    as.character(tbl$Residue)
  )

  missing_residues <- setdiff(
    residue_order,
    available_residues
  )

  if (length(missing_residues) > 0) {
    stop(
      "The following requested residue type(s) are absent from tbl: ",
      paste(
        missing_residues,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  plot_data <- tbl %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Residue = as.character(Residue),
      d = as.integer(d),
      rho = as.numeric(rho),
      ARL1 = as.numeric(ARL1),
      S_chart_ARL1 = as.numeric(S_chart_ARL1)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Residue %in% residue_order
    )

  invalid_rows <- plot_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.na(d) |
      is.na(rho) |
      !is.finite(rho) |
      rho <= 0 |
      is.na(ARL1) |
      ARL1 <= 0 |
      is.na(S_chart_ARL1) |
      S_chart_ARL1 <= 0
    )

  if (nrow(invalid_rows) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The plotting data contain missing, nonpositive, or ",
        "invalid values of d, rho, ARL1, or S_chart_ARL1."
      )
    )
  }

  duplicate_rows <- plot_data %>%
    dplyr::count(
      Residue,
      d,
      rho,
      name = "n_rows"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      n_rows > 1
    )

  if (nrow(duplicate_rows) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Multiple rows were found for at least one ",
        "Residue, d, and rho combination."
      )
    )
  }

  benchmark_check <- plot_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      Residue,
      rho
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_benchmark_values =
        dplyr::n_distinct(S_chart_ARL1),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      n_benchmark_values > 1
    )

  if (nrow(benchmark_check) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The conventional S-chart ARL1 benchmark varies ",
        "across d for at least one Residue and rho combination."
      )
    )
  }

  nonfinite_rows <- plot_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.finite(ARL1) |
      !is.finite(S_chart_ARL1)
    )

  if (nrow(nonfinite_rows) > 0) {
    warning(
      paste0(
        nrow(nonfinite_rows),
        " row(s) with infinite ARL1 values were omitted ",
        "because infinite values cannot be plotted."
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(ARL1),
      is.finite(S_chart_ARL1)
    )

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No finite ARL1 values remain for plotting."
    )
  }

  rho_breaks <- sort(
    unique(plot_data$rho)
  )

  make_residue_plot <- function(
    residue_name
  ) {

    residue_data <- plot_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        Residue == residue_name
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(
        d,
        rho
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        d_label = factor(
          paste0("d = ", d),
          levels = paste0(
            "d = ",
            sort(unique(d))
          )
        )
      )

    if (nrow(residue_data) == 0) {
      stop(
        "No finite plotting data were found for residue ",
        residue_name,
        "."
      )
    }

    benchmark_data <- residue_data %>%
      dplyr::select(
        rho,
        S_chart_ARL1
      ) %>%
      dplyr::distinct() %>%
      dplyr::arrange(
        rho
      )

    residue_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
      ggplot2::geom_line(
        data = residue_data,
        mapping = ggplot2::aes(
          x = rho,
          y = ARL1,
          color = d_label,
          group = d_label
        ),
        linewidth = 0.85,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )

    if (isTRUE(show_points)) {
      residue_plot <- residue_plot +
        ggplot2::geom_point(
          data = residue_data,
          mapping = ggplot2::aes(
            x = rho,
            y = ARL1,
            color = d_label,
            group = d_label
          ),
          size = 1.8,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
    }

    residue_plot <- residue_plot +
      ggplot2::geom_line(
        data = benchmark_data,
        mapping = ggplot2::aes(
          x = rho,
          y = S_chart_ARL1,
          linetype = "S-chart ARL1 benchmark"
        ),
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 1.3,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        data = benchmark_data,
        mapping = ggplot2::aes(
          x = rho,
          y = S_chart_ARL1
        ),
        color = "black",
        shape = 18,
        size = 2.7,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = rho_breaks,
        labels = formatC(
          rho_breaks,
          format = "f",
          digits = 2
        )
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual(
        name = NULL,
        values = c(
          "S-chart ARL1 benchmark" = "longdash"
        )
      ) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = paste0(
          residue_name,
          " ARL1 curves"
        ),
        x = expression(
          "Multiplicative variability ratio, " * rho
        ),
        y = expression(ARL[1]),
        color = "d-CCSSBU-S candidate"
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_bw(
        base_size = base_size
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
          face = "bold",
          hjust = 0
        ),
        panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(
          face = "bold"
        )
      )

    if (isTRUE(y_log10)) {
      residue_plot <- residue_plot +
        ggplot2::scale_y_log10()
    }

    residue_plot
  }

  residue_plots <- lapply(
    residue_order,
    make_residue_plot
  )

  names(residue_plots) <- residue_order

  combined_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    residue_plots,
    ncol = 1,
    guides = "collect"
  ) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title = paste0(
        "d-CCSSBU-S and conventional S-chart ARL1 curves for ",
        equipment_label
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
       "Candidate curves versus the conventional ",
        "S-chart ARL1 benchmark curve."
      ),
      theme = ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
          face = "bold",
          size = base_size + 3,
          hjust = 0.5
        ),
        plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
          size = base_size,
          hjust = 0.5
        )
      )
    ) &
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  if (is.null(output_file)) {

    equipment_file_name <- tolower(
      trimws(equipment_label)
    )

    equipment_file_name <- gsub(
      pattern = "[^a-z0-9]+",
      replacement = "-",
      x = equipment_file_name
    )

    equipment_file_name <- gsub(
      pattern = "^-+|-+$",
      replacement = "",
      x = equipment_file_name
    )

    output_file <- paste0(
      "d-ccssbu-s-arl1-curves-",
      equipment_file_name,
      ".png"
    )
  }

  if (
    length(output_file) != 1 ||
    is.na(output_file) ||
    !nzchar(trimws(output_file))
  ) {
    stop(
      "output_file must be one nonempty character value."
    )
  }

  if (!grepl(
  pattern = "\\.(png|jpg|jpeg)$",
  x = output_file,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)) {
  output_file <- paste0(
    output_file,
    ".png"
  )
  }
  

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = output_file,
    plot = combined_plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in",
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )

  message(
    "The ARL1 curve figure was saved to: ",
    normalizePath(
      output_file,
      winslash = "/",
      mustWork = FALSE
    )
  )

  invisible(
    list(
      plot = combined_plot,
      panels = residue_plots,
      output_file = output_file,
      plotting_data = plot_data
    )
  )
}
```

## d-CCSSBU-S Selection of $d$ and ARL1 Results for Equipment A

- run the function `d_ccssbu_s_d_selection_arl1()`
- generate the csv file `d_CCSSBU_s_ARL1_Equipment_A_tbl_wide.csv` use `readr::write_csv()`
- generate Table 3 in the paper by the function `render_d_ccssbu_s_recommendation_tbl()` using argument `tbl =  d_CCSSBU_S_ARL1_Equipment_A_recommendation`
- generate ARL$_1$ curve by `plot_d_ccssbu_s_arl1_curves()` and the curve picture name is `d-ccssbu-s-arl1-curves-equipment-a.jpeg`
